college_info.intro:
FIIB Delhi popular programmes are PGDM and PGDM FM. FIIB Delhi PGDM students can become Investment Bankers, Finance Analysts, Commercial Bankers. and others. PGDM is offered in seven specialisations. During the course, emphasis is put on Business analytics, leadership, and strategy. The students are also taught current trends and various transformations, including social responsibility and entrepreneurship skills.
FIIB Delhi's PGDM FM course is a specially designed course for individuals aspiring to excel in the Financial field. The course involves a fusion of finance with data analytics. FIIB Delhi's PGDM FM students can choose career paths such as Investment and Wealth Management, Risk Management, Valuation, and Strategy, and others. Overall, these course students are placed in top companies such as Asian Paints, American Express, and others. Below mentioned are some of the courses offered by FIIB Delhi and their respective eligibility and FIIB MBA fees:

placements.overview:
The PGDM batch of 2023-25 at FIIB Delhi consisted of 226 students, of which 215 students opted to participate in the placement process. Among them, 15 students secured multiple job offers, while 27 students received offers from their first-choice companies.

The highest package accepted during FIIB placements 2025 stood at INR 25 LPA. While, the average package stood at INR 8.5 LPA with a placement rate of 96%. Over 135 recruiters visited the institute during the 2025 PGDM placement drive 2025. The leading recruiters include Asian Paints, Flipkart, Deloitte, Wipro, etc. The average stipend offered to PGDM students in 2025 was INR 25,000. 100% internship offers were made in 2025.

placement_data.title: FIIB Delhi Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The PGDM batch of 2023-25 comprised 226 students . Out of total students, 39.3% were female students. 43.4% students enrolled in this batch were from Commerce background whereas 24.3% students were from Management stream. Students with Science background was 17.7%. The remaining 14.2% students were from Arts and Other background.

A total of 215 students (91.5%) opted for placements during FIIB Delhi PGDM placements 2025. 15 students (6.6%) received more than 1 offer whereas 27 students (11.9%) got offers from their first choice of company during Fortune Institute of International Business PGDM placement 2025.

There was consistent increase in BFSI, Consulting and FMCG roles during PGDM placement 2025. 29% of Pre-Placement offers came from the Internship drive . Top roles of Management Trainee , HR Generalist, Market Research Analyst, Financial Analyst and Data Analyst were offered this year. The CIP (Corporate Internship Program) is conducted by the Institute. In this program, students undergo 12-week internship to gain real-time experience in their preferred domains.

Talking about classrooms, these are very spacious and are fully air conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good for management students.

Our college provides a smart library in which we have EBSCO and Pearson accounts. The overall campus gives you a luxurious life.

reviews.review_heading: Xavier institute of management and entrepreneurship .
reviews.review_text: Here, campus life is both beautiful and tense, The library provide wide range of books, articles, journals, etc. It is such a rich source of gathering information. Classrooms are well-equipped with an AC, board, bench, chair, and projectors in every room. Each room in the hostel can accommodate two students, and both AC and non-AC options are available. Mess food is bad North Indian people are a little tough to adjust to; non-vegetarian food is good, but vegetarians need to adjust.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is small but good in terms of ROI, and placements in 2022 are good.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a gym, computer labs, library, basketball court, badminton court, garden, parking facility, TV, etc. There are smart TVs in classrooms and simulation-based learning. The quality of facilities in the hostel is good. There are 2 seater rooms available in the hostel. The mess food is not great but not that bad.

reviews.review_heading: A really good year for placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus is located 15 minutes away from the nearest metro station and you can get Ola and Uber very easily for the same. We have a main campus building two different hostels for girls and boys separately. The campus and Hostel are fully equipped with a 24x7 Wi-Fi facility. The boys hostel has a football ground, basketball court and also a badminton court. The food quality in the mess is good but not the best. The college has tie-ups with nearby hospitals for quick and rapid medical facilities...

reviews.review_heading: This college provides excellent placements opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and overall with a Wi-Fi facility available in the hostel as well as on campus. There is mess and canteen facility available. Food is average in mess. There is also sports, medical and club facility. The hostel is excellent with boys and girls hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It has good placements, crowd, learnings, etc.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good in our campus and hostel. The facilities provided are also very good. The quality of food and variety offered is good. It has a Wi-Fi-enabled campus. It has a hostel and computer lab. Classrooms are equipped with a projector, sound system, and air-conditioned. The library is both digital and physical and provides access to journals and all course-related books. If you require any new book, the library orders it for you.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college with the best placements and a lots of learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided by the college is well sufficient for around 200 students on the campus. Being a residential campus, the hostels are connected with the college campus. It is Wi-Fi enabled campus and has hostels, air-conditioners, well-equipped classrooms, a resourceful library, basketball, and badminton grounds. The quality of food available in the mess is good with a menu including both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, while cuisines from North and South India.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it was a great experience with hardships at the same time much more moments to cherish.
reviews.review_text: Though the campus is small it is well established and is Wi-Fi enabled campus.  We also have centralised air-conditioners across classes and the library. Management and non-teaching staff always tried their best to maintain hygiene and a clean environment. The best part of our college life is hostels with twin sharing with attached bathrooms which are cleaned thrice a week. Even though PGDM life is a bit hectic the sports facilities and gymnasium helps students to maintain their physical and men...

reviews.review_heading: XIME Kochi is a great place to learn.
reviews.review_text: This college has a well-established infrastructure, equipped with all the essential facilities. It has medical assistance and tie-ups with good private hospitals in Kochi. Sports facilities are also good enough. It also has a well-equipped gym, and the college canteen is quite hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Review Xavier Institute of Management and Entrepreneurship, Kochi.
reviews.review_text: The campus is completely Wi-Fi enabled. Library facilities are excellent, and it is open from 8:30 AM to 8:30 PM. All the classrooms are air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: XIME has good discipline and time management.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good, and there are 2 students sharing a room with an attached bathroom. The room is spacious and the hostel food is also good and different meals are served on different days and at different times. The best part of the college is that it has attached hostels which means you don't have to travel much to get into classes.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and facilities of our college are satisfactory.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi within the campus is good, but in hostel, it's not up to the mark. There are good sports facilities available within the campus. Well-built and maintained basketball and badminton courts are there. Several indoor games along with gym facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: The return on investment as compared to other colleges is far more better.
reviews.review_text: Though the campus is small, you find all basic amenities such as a gym,  24/7 Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classes, stationary, library, labs, etc. Talking about food, in breakfast, we generally get South Indian food like dosa, vada, idli, appam, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best b-school for a good career.
reviews.review_text: It provides very well-maintained and highly efficient laboratories and infrastructure. The class was best, and the hostel accommodation was very comfortable for all. The food was good as well. Management was very supportive of all sports and give funds to buy the same. Hospital facilities nearby and on-campus also sufficient facilities were available.

reviews.review_heading: XIME has a culture with diversity.
reviews.review_text: XIME provides the PGDM course only, so its infrastructure is decent. It has all the necessities that a future manager will look for. XIME-K has smart classes, gym, computer labs, and a library with a vast collection of books. The hostel is compulsory for all. The hostel rooms are allotted one each for 2 students with attached washroom. Cleaning is done on a regular basis.

faqs.answer: A:    The eligibility criteria for MBA course at AIMS Institutes  is that candidate should have passed with a minimum of 50% aggregate in a 3 or 4 years Bachelors programme from a recognised body. faqs.question: What is the AIMS Institutes eligibility?

faqs.answer: A:    Yes, AIMS Institutes accepts national-level entrance exams for MBA admission. The institute accepts CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT or ATMA score for providing admission to MBA programme. For other courses, the admission is based on merit in the last qualifying exam.
faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by AIMS Institutes?

faqs.answer: A:    No, you can not get into AIMS Institutes BBA with just 70% in class 12th as the university accepts different entrance exams dor admission into the BBA programme. AIMS Bangalore admission criteria is based on a valid score in PGCET (MBA) / CAT / MAT / XAT / ATMA or any national admission test. You also need to have a bachelor’s degree with at least 50% marks in aggregate from a recognised university. You can apply online for the MBA programme on their official website.

faqs.question: Can I get into AIMS Institutes BBA with 70% in class 12th?

admission_process.title: Ramaiah Institute of Management Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Ramaiah Institute of Management (MSRIM) admission is merit and entrance-based for programmes offered at PG, Certificate and Doctoral levels. For merit-based admissions to courses such as PGDM, PGDM (IEV), PGP, etc.,MSRIMconsiders scores of Class 12 and graduation levels. However, Ramaiah Institute of Management admissions to PhD and PGDM (Online) programme, candidates are admitted based on respective entrance exam scores. Moreover, candidates can apply on the online mode for admission to their desired programme.

Ramaiah Institute of Management courses are offered at PG and Doctoral levels. Candidates must meet the basic educational requirements to be eligible for admission to their respective courses. Tabulate below are the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for Ramaiah Institute of Management course admissions:
Graduates from any discipline/Students in their final year of graduation can also apply/Budding Entrepreneurs/ Mid-level Managers/2nd & 3rd Generation Entrepreneurs
CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT/ATMA+ GD/PI
PGP Sports Management
Know more aboutMSRIM courses
The step-by-steps details for Ramaiah Institute of Management admission process are as follows:
Step 1: Application Process

The application process at MSRIM is conducted in online mode. Candidates need to apply for PG and Doctoral level courses at the college's official website. Along with that, candidates must also pay an application fee before submitting the form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to MSRIM is both merit and entrance-based. Candidates are offered direct admission to PGDM, PGDM (IEV), PGP and other courses. However, for admission to PhD and PGDM (Online course), candidates are admitted based on their scores obtained in the relevant entrance exams. Moreover, a GD and PI round is also conducted for the final selection.
Step 3: Final Admission
After the completion of all the selection rounds, the selected candidates must pay a certain amount of fee to confirm their seats.

paragraphs: The admission process ofRV Institute of Managementinvolves various steps. The details are mentioned below::
Application Process

For MBA admissions, students have to visit the official website of the accepted entrance exam and register themselves for the exam. Those with a valid score in the exams can visit the official website of the institute and apply it by filling out the form available.
Selection Process

The institute shortlists students for its MBA programme on the basis of both the entrance exam and management quota. Those with a valid score in the national or state-level management entrance tests will be shortlisted by the institute. Students applying for the management quota admission have to appear for the RVIM Aptitude test and Personality Skill test (Essay Test) online within two days after paying the fee. The next round will consist of a GDPI conducted by the institute to finalise the list of students.
Admission Confirmation

To confirm their admission to the institute students have to pay the fee and go through verification (if required). Shortlisted students need to come for document verification and pay thefeeto confirm their seats at the institute.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for MBA Course.
reviews.review_text: An excellent MBA program is offered by RV Institute. The college has a huge, lovely campus. The college offers its students Wi-Fi, labs, a library, a canteen, sports, and other amenities. These buildings are all good. The hotel's amenities were very good. Both the restaurant and the mess had delicious cuisine. College officials give a large number of stadiums.

reviews.review_heading: A short review for the MBA at RV Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: RV Institute has a good infrastructure for the MBA course. The college campus is pretty big and beautiful. The college has Wi-Fi, labs, a library, a canteen, sports and various other facilities for its students. All these facilities are of good quality. The quality of the facilities in the hostel was also good. The food available in the mess and canteen was also good. Multiple sports facilities are offered by the college management.

reviews.review_heading: It's a very good place for one to study, learn, and enjoy with good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college was quite eco-friendly with a lot of space for cultural events and sports. We had Wi-Fi throughout the campus. The hostel had an ambiance like home. Our hostel and canteen facilities were very excellent with a good menu option for all students.

reviews.review_heading: Really good college in-terms of academic and placements.
reviews.review_text:
1. College have all the facilities like WI-Fi, Labs, Classrooms and library and also they have opened a incubation centre in the college to cater students to bring their start-up ideas to life. And they have a huge database to provide information on any of the idea. 
2. Boys hostel is not in the campus, its located 4.8 km away (In Basavanagudi) from the college and no transportation facility. Students have to travel by their own vehicle or use public transport.

reviews.review_heading: College has good infrastructure & placement. Training session is organized every Saturday.
reviews.review_text: Library consists of good amount of newspaper, Journals and huge collection of management books but lacks books on other discipline. Wi-Fi facility is available. There are 4 labs and no shortage of devices. College has very good infrastructure. Hostel is four kilometers far from college having low facility.

reviews.review_heading: The college life provided me beautiful memories to remember.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good compared to the other tier-2 colleges in the city. Each department like finance, human resource, marketing, EDP and CSR has separate blocks. Facilities like gym, library, digital library, sports room, canteen, seminar hall, conference hall and classrooms with projectors are available.

reviews.review_heading: A worth for the money and great place to study.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Facilities are also good. Classrooms and labs are spacious. Library is large and has good collection of course materials and books. College also has digital library. One more unique feature is, college has got AV studio. Many courses will be there through out the year for the benefit of students.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with everything.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is amazing and well-designed. There are four floors, which consists different specialisation and labs. There are many labs in this college and has about more than three hundred PCs. I am truly satisfied with this college.

reviews.review_heading: Placements in this college are really good. There is best in class infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college has a beautifully built separate building for MBA campus where they have 3 digital labs with internet facility and one sick room for resting in case of any medical emergency. The classrooms are well spacious with decent seating facilities and also all classrooms are provided with projectors. There are a seminar hall and a conference hall where various workshops and conferences are held in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college. But, they are little bit strict in their rules and regulations.
reviews.review_text: It has a cool infrastructure, and the department of every stream is easy to locate. The campus is located in the middle of the city where everything is nearby. The infrastructure is eco-friendly. The classrooms are large. The library and digital labs are also available.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best and premier institute for doing MBA.
reviews.review_text: One of the best infrastructures in Bangalore, dedicated campus for the master of business administration alone. The campus is filled with the lush green creepers. The campus has well-equipped laboratories, and each class has both smart as well as board equipped halls. There are incubation centre and two seminar halls.

reviews.review_heading: This is a good college producing some good, professional students.
reviews.review_text: There is a good library, good outlook and a good infrastructure available in the college. I think that this is the only college that teaches just MBA alone in the whole of the Karnataka state. The college does not respect the sports and games, but you will get some opportunities for sure. All the classrooms are smart classes with the projectors. There is a good seminar hall as well among the others.

reviews.review_heading: Good place for MBA, value for money, good place for just passed UG freshers.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure is very well-maintained and very hygienic. Wi-Fi is available on request and classrooms are facilitated with well-maintained projectors, boards and good lighting.
2 seminar halls, 2 digital labs and a digital library for more knowledge sharing are available for students' use.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the overall quality of management and of service they render.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure is good and it's in the centre of the city, which helps all the students in transportation.
They have a good library and a good number of labs. They support for extra curricular activities like dance, fests, drama, etc. It's fun being an RV student.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for the students, their career and their life.
reviews.review_text:
We have good facilities in our college when comparing to the other colleges like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms with smart class facilities, transportation, sports and games etc available in our campus.
The quality of classrooms was good and we have a canteen facility with a variety of food available all the time.
We do not have hostel facilities. 
We did not face any infrastructure-related issues in our college.

review_content.Placements: In my course, there are no placements till now. We're informed that placements for the English department will be starting from this year. Till now, no companies have come. I had given an interview at TCS which I couldn't crack because it is not departmental.
review_content.Infrastructure: We are being given Wi-Fi in hostel rooms, classrooms, library, and canteens. Classes are air-conditioned with a projector in every classroom. The quality of food served is good and hygienic. Here we have 4 canteens and one mess. The food served is not very spicy but tasty.

reviews_list.review_title: Peaceful green campus, supportive faculty members, and decent placement.

review_content.Placements: 98% of students got placed. The highest salary was 13.8 LPA, the lowest was 5 LPA, and average package was 6.8 LPA. Big 4 companies like Deloitte, KPMG, HDFC, and Axis Bank. Internship and placement were 100% at companies like Federal Bank, KPMG, and EY. individual_reviews.course: M.A. in English - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied due to placement offers.

content.Placements: In my course, there are no placements till now. We're informed that placements for the English department will be starting from this year. Till now, no companies have come. I had given an interview at TCS which I couldn't crack because it is not departmental.
content.Infrastructure: We are being given Wi-Fi in hostel rooms, classrooms, library, and canteens. Classes are air-conditioned with a projector in every classroom. The quality of food served is good and hygienic. Here we have 4 canteens and one mess. The food served is not very spicy but tasty.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Peaceful green campus, supportive faculty members, and decent placement.

content.Placements: 98% of students got placed. The highest salary was 13.8 LPA, the lowest was 5 LPA, and average package was 6.8 LPA. Big 4 companies like Deloitte, KPMG, HDFC, and Axis Bank. Internship and placement were 100% at companies like Federal Bank, KPMG, and EY. Banking and financial roles offered in Federal, HDFC, and ICICI Banks. Marketing people were strong at EY.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provided Wi-Fi and IT infrastructure, classroom and lectures halls, central library - 17,000 books, animation lab, computer lab, agriculture lab, etc. It provided seperate boys and girls hostels. There was a common room in hostel with TV, indoor games, and free Wi-Fi. We had gym and fitness, central dinning hall, mess, and kaivalya kitchen. Total 4 canteens were available. It had ISO certified kitchen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: B.Sc. (hons) agriculture in SSU.

content.Placements: Placement of agricultural courses is not that exciting. You can get placed in industrial applications or in some sort of government scheme or job. Mostly pursuing a PG after this course is recommended so that you can add more skills to your resume.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel and college infrastructure are great. Hostel is beautiful and lush with greenery all around. The girl's hostel is near the academic building which is very helpful as this proximity means we don't get tired much. But the boys' rooms are very far almost 1 km, so they have to walk to commute to class.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in English - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of B.A. (Hons.) in English course at Sri Sri University.

content.Placements: Here the English course is average, if students aim to get a degree then this course is for them. But if students expect placements with good packages then they will be disappointed. So do not expect any high-package placements that social media or word of mouth is spreading.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms are fairly spacious and good in terms of amenities. The infrastructure is also good. This college follows Indian traditions and culture so all buildings and greenery are very natural and green. The infrastructure is very good in my opinion.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) IBM - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Food is average and all good here.

content.Placements: As of now, being a 2nd batch B.Tech student, there is no great record of any company to come. It gives a really good package starting from a mere barrier of 8 LPA, then even comes and offers packages around 5 LPA which is poor in the current market demand.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good. Classrooms are nearly clean, which gives good experience to learn things when teachers come to explain the new concepts. Hostel facility is good for living. Good room conditions with bathroom and electricity facilities are available. In mess, standard food quality they offer so mostly students don't opt to give mess fee rather, they have outside food sometimes in a week.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied due to placement offers.
reviews.review_text: We are being given Wi-Fi in hostel rooms, classrooms, library, and canteens. Classes are air-conditioned with a projector in every classroom. The quality of food served is good and hygienic. Here we have 4 canteens and one mess. The food served is not very spicy but tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Peaceful green campus, supportive faculty members, and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided Wi-Fi and IT infrastructure, classroom and lectures halls, central library - 17,000 books, animation lab, computer lab, agriculture lab, etc. It provided seperate boys and girls hostels. There was a common room in hostel with TV, indoor games, and free Wi-Fi. We had gym and fitness, central dinning hall, mess, and kaivalya kitchen. Total 4 canteens were available. It had ISO certified kitchen.

reviews.review_heading: B.Sc. (hons) agriculture in SSU.
reviews.review_text: Hostel and college infrastructure are great. Hostel is beautiful and lush with greenery all around. The girl's hostel is near the academic building which is very helpful as this proximity means we don't get tired much. But the boys' rooms are very far almost 1 km, so they have to walk to commute to class.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B.A. (Hons.) in English course at Sri Sri University.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are fairly spacious and good in terms of amenities. The infrastructure is also good. This college follows Indian traditions and culture so all buildings and greenery are very natural and green. The infrastructure is very good in my opinion.

reviews.review_heading: Food is average and all good here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good. Classrooms are nearly clean, which gives good experience to learn things when teachers come to explain the new concepts. Hostel facility is good for living. Good room conditions with bathroom and electricity facilities are available. In mess, standard food quality they offer so mostly students don't opt to give mess fee rather, they have outside food sometimes in a week.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good. It's a vegetarian campus so many students may have difficulties.
reviews.review_text: The good library with plenty of books and Wi-Fi is not working properly some of the time, they don't take us to the lab they just make us do the lab in virtual mode. Hostel rooms are normal but the quality of food is very bad. It has a hospital inside the campus and encourages us to participate in different types of sports.

reviews.review_heading: Sri University: Great infrastructure and decent placements, but the faculty needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Sri University offers excellent facilities, including a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, modern labs (computer, design, physics, and electronics), and air-conditioned classrooms with projectors and smart boards. An extensive library with digital resources, sports facilities (cricket, football, basketball, badminton, volleyball), a gym, auditorium, cafeteria, medical facilities with 24/7 ambulance service and well maintained hostels with attached bathrooms and laundry services.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the type of infrastructure and good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in my college include classrooms with strong Wi-Fi connectivity and a library with all kinds of books and study materials. Excellent quality food in both the mess and canteen, excellent medical facilities, and all kinds of sports equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Overall really good, lack around the faculty response and placements.
reviews.review_text: A good infrastructure overall especially the cyber lab is good. One where you can have access to it any time and also good equipments which are easy to use for the students. Even for those who are not from computer backgrounds can always understand it clear.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, and the teachers are also good. I would like to make changes to syllabus.
reviews.review_text: There are 3 computer labs, and every lab is for each subject, like the solar lab, physics, basic electronics, and math lab. The hostels are the best in the university because they are new buildings. A generator is also there, a lift is also available, 3 time meal, a hospital for medical emergencies with an ambulance, and sports fields too.

reviews.review_heading: Students can come here if they want to get more spiritual and calm alongside their studies.
reviews.review_text: It has all things like a library, Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms. But, I have nearly completed my first year and yet have to go to the lab of the non-IT subjects. We have only done those in virtual labs. The hostel facilities here are good, and meals are great except for a few ones. Our university is a only vegetarian campus. We do have a hospital here but I have not visited any so I am not sure how great they are. For sports, I do not recommend students this place.

reviews.review_heading: Great option if you can work on your skills by yourself. The campus and crowd are great.
reviews.review_text: Our college has amazing green campus and hostels are also good. Hostels have attached washrooms and are not common for multiple rooms. The campus buildings are well-connected. The campus roads are surrounded by trees and plants and greenery. Full points when it comes to campus and hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty members, good placements, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The main thing is the infrastructure. You will be surprised to see that the infrastructure of this university is also very good. After 2 years, the infrastructure is becoming more fantastic.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome faculty members, cyber dojo is the best, alcohol and drugs free campus.
reviews.review_text: Our college has 24X7 AC and Wi-Fi. It has best library. Canteen serves awesome food. We have an ayurvedic hospital. We have a badminton court, tennis court, volleyball court, football and cricket ground, and nets for practice. As well as we have table tennis, carrom, and chess and the seniors are awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Worth it brother - Habibi come to SSU.
reviews.review_text: You will get a nice library and it's so calm and everything is good. Sports plays a vital role at SSU. Infrastructure at SSU building is great. Like I can't describe it if you visit you will definitely like it. There are 10 hostels, 5 (girls) and 5 (boys). Free gym facility for both boys and girls. As well as you can go for yoga also it's free of cost. As we all know that mess food is not good but still it's good. You will get 3 more cafeterias on the campus.

college_info.college_name: Sri Sri University Scholarship Details

paragraphs: Sri Sri University awards scholarships based on the provable merit of the enrolled students. The scholarships are provided in the form of tuition fee waivers in each discipline per academic year. Sri Sri University also offers Endowment Scholarships for the financial aid of the students.
All the scholarships by the university are offered based on the merit of the students. Check below the selection criteria and selection procedure for Sri Sri University scholarships:
Selection procedure:

Selection criteria: The student must have a meritorious track record in the course he or she is pursuing from the university. Excellence in extra-curricular activities and financial hardship of the student is also considered for awarding the scholarship.
The university provides tuition fee waivers and Endowment scholarships to meritorious students. Check the details for the Sri Sri University scholarships:

Students who are enrolled in a course are eligible for a tuition fee waiver for a specific semester or academic year. The scholarship criteria will be defined by the committee following the guidelines of the university.
The below mentioned-categories will be considered for a 25% tuition fee waiver:
Category

PG course (SSU-CET topper candidate in respective faculty/ department)

Poor economic background

SSU in-house UG students (any stream) who wish to pursue PG course from SSU and are eligible for the scholarship in MBA, MCom, MA Yoga Science and MA Sanskrit. Check below the details of the scholarships offered for these courses:
Course Name
Total Discount

Endowment scholarships are instituted in the name of the philanthropist/ donors/ family donations, etc. Here are the details of Endowment scholarship offered by Sri Sri University:
Download: Sri Sri University Scholarships for more details

Eligible students can apply for scholarships by filling out the application form. The forms are then scrutinised based on merit criteria specified by the scholarship committee. Students can enquire about the scholarship forms in the admission office.

The scholarship committee makes a semester-wise assessment of students’ progress to consider their application for scholarship renewal. Evaluation criteria for the renewal is set by the committee. Students need to maintain good grades with no backlog in each semester and academic year.
Note: The award of scholarship may be offered to other students in case any awardee loses his eligibility to avail the scholarship.

reviews.review_heading: SBUP's review by a student .
reviews.review_text: The campus of Sri Balaji University in Pune is huge. Designed in such a way that helps students grow multidimensionally. On a lush green campus, classrooms are well-equipped, with water coolers in each class separately, air conditioning, and a large library too.

reviews.review_heading: Very good facilities are provided by the college.
reviews.review_text: I opted for the hostel. The hostel is only provided for the 1st year students after which you have to shift to flats in a society nearby. There are many societies near the college where flats with every facility are available at affordable rents and the students can reside there on a sharing basis. Average rent is around 10k -15k which can be shared between 3-4 students. External expenses may be around ₹4000-7000.

reviews.review_heading: The best university of my life .
reviews.review_text: The hostel of our college is excellent, with separate facilities for boys and girls. The rooms are well-maintained, with three students sharing one room. The room facilities include an attached bathroom, and the staff ensures daily cleaning. The mess in our hostel is also good, with excellent taste, quality, and quantity of food.

reviews.review_heading: I like the campus infrastructure and environment.
reviews.review_text: The college has got a very good hostel separate for boys and separate for girls. For security CCTV cameras are placed around every corridors so that no theft can happen. The Rooms are also quite big and comfortable. There are three Maths in the college and the food of all three is good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides great learning opportunities leading towards a good career.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was excellent. Sri Balaji University offered the best facilities like computer labs, library, neat classrooms, newspaper reading, etc. The quality of other facilities provided such as the cleanliness of the campus, and the mess area was too good. The food served was decent, and we had a dedicated first aid room. Many recreational activities were also held.

reviews.review_heading: This college has very good value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is top-notch. There are two auditoriums with a seating capacity of more than 1,000 students. The entire campus is equipped with a Wi-Fi facility, and the computer labs are also very good. The hostel has an accommodation capacity of around 600 students. The hostel has a gym, swimming pool, basketball court, volleyball court and indoor games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Best in terms of fees and recruitment.
reviews.review_text: The college has the best classrooms. It gives a very positive vibe. It is full of windows which give fresh air every time and the class receives lot of natural sunlight. The labs are very best as everything is taught practically, it has an exact number of laptops for all the students.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely dissatisfied due to the rigorous academic schedule of our college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for this course are satisfactory. The quality of the food served inside the campus is also very good. But students who stay in the college hostel have to follow some rules and regulations. They do not get much freedom compared to the students who stay outside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: There is some room for improvement in the curriculum section.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure in my view is very good as in our campus you got to live quality life. There are four separate building comprises of 4 different colleges stand together where more than 1000 students study various specializations. The whole infrastructure of this college is very good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is very good. Every technical equipment is available here, which is needed by students. Every institute of our college has a separate library, which has a very good collection of books. In the mess, there are no huge eating options. However, the food they serve is very healthy and nutritious.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life here is amazing. A lot of events are held to cherish and enjoy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. Labs library, etc., are good. Even we have good hostel facilities. The quality of food served in the college mess mostly both north or south India dishes, and mostly any cultures dish you will get here so that the students do not get bored by the same food. Proper sports events are held every year for good recreation of the students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college maintains discipline and is dedicated.
reviews.review_text: Our college has an excellent quality of infrastructure, along with well-furnished classrooms and library. The quality of the food served here is awesome, and the mess is very clean. Varieties of food items are served in it, and we can choose them according to our wish. There is an ambulance in our hostel which provides 24x7 service to students.

individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with what is happening.

content.Placements: 80 per cent are placed. 24 LPA is the highest package, 2 LPA is the lowest, and the average is 2.5 LPA. MuSigma is the highest recruiting company in the State. 30% of students got an internship at Wipro and TCS. Sales and Software engineer interns are offered.

individual_reviews.title: Great campus with excellent facilities and strict attendance.

content.Placements: 65 to 60 percent of students got placed last year. The lowest package is 3.5 LPA, the average is 6 LPA-10 LPA, and the highest is 35 LPA. Software developer, cloud engineer, and data analyst are roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is quite good. Labs are not that good. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned, libraries are big, the quality of food is great, top medical facilities, and big grounds for each sport and game. Sometimes Wi-Fi stops working for 2 or 3 days. Labs are mainly considered as a free period.

individual_reviews.title: Review of campus life, which is exciting and amazing.

content.Faculty: Teachers are so helpful and very qualified. Semester exams are not so difficult, but are at a good standard level. The course curriculum is good. Exams level is good. Faculty members are very supportive, and they give us direction for our lives and also for placements.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in International Business - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am really blessed to be in this college.

content.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch. There is a Wi-Fi facility in all classrooms with a comfortable branch and library. The infrastructure is amazing, and each building has a library. The quality of education is good.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is the best university in India with good placements.

Dayananda Sagar University was was started as a part of Dayananda Sagar Institutions in the year of 2014. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) in association with IoA, UK - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good learning experience at Bharath Institute with supportive faculty and placements.

content.Placements: Most of the students in our batch got placed in reputed companies. The average package is decent compared to other colleges in the region. Companies like Infosys, TCS, and Cognizant visited for recruitment. A good number of students also got internships during the final year, which helped improve their practical exposure.
content.Infrastructure: College has good infrastructure with spacious classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a digital library. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. The hostel facilities are neat and maintained regularly. Canteen food is average but hygienic. There are facilities for indoor and outdoor games as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science) in association with UPGRAD Campus - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good college. Placements in 2015 show that 65 percent of students are selected in campus placements.

content.Placements: Students from the CSE branch are selected by Accenture. A total of 1,100 students participated in placements, but 650 students were selected. The highest package is 27 LPA. Companies like Accenture, sales, manufacturing companies, Infosys, Wipro, and HCL are involved in placements. It is good for studying, and the campus has anti-ragging policies.
content.Infrastructure: All mentioned facilities are good, with available AC and non-AC rooms. Wi-Fi and labs are available, with good infrastructure, AC classrooms, and a central library on our campus. Medical services, including a hospital, are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good college, good infrastructure, good staff.

content.Placements: 75% of students got placed. The top recruiting company is Accenture. 90% of students got internships in software development. In our college, many companies are coming and recruiting students with better packages. The lowest package was 3 LPA. The highest package is around 27 LPA. The average package is around 10 LPA. We participate in the campus recruitment drive, and I completed the Bluebridge first interview; the second stage will be on an unannounced date.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is very good. The library is very peaceful; the classrooms are very good, and the labs are all in good condition. Wi-Fi is available all around the college. Hostel food is very nice, and hostel rooms are also very good. There is also a big medical hospital available on campus. The canteen is very neat and decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Sometimes, it is good, but not all the time.

content.Placements: Only 10% of students get placed in my college. The highest package is 6.75 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.1 LPA. The top recruiting companies at my college are Cognizant and Accenture. Many students join online internships in Internpe, EduSkills, etc. The top role offered is a software engineer associate.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good and not bad. There is Wi-Fi for students and staff members. Labs are there for practicals. Classrooms are neatly cleaned up daily, and in each classroom, there is AC. The library is good and peaceful. It consists of all books and a good infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Law LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of Bharath Institute of Higher Education and Research.

content.Placements: College offers plenty of opportunities for students to get placed and the staff members are very supportive when it comes to securing jobs. There's an active placement cell that works hard to help students with both placements and internships. Many MNCs and technical companies visit the campus for hiring. Internship opportunities are also good with a stipend of around Rs 12,000.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is impressive. There is big playground and spacious auditorium that can fit about 1000 people giving enough space for events. Classrooms are okay, not too fancy, but they serve the purpose. The college doesn't organize sports events, which is a bit disappointing. Library is a real highlight. It's huge and has a wide collection of books, so there's plenty of space to study.

admission_overview.college_name: Bharath University Course Admission 2025: Eligibility, Selection Criteria, Application

paragraphs: Bharath University (Deemed-to-be) admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. The university conducts its own Bharath Engineering Entrance Examination (BEEE) to provide admission to UG Engineering courses.Bharath Institute of Higher Education and Researchalso accepts national-level entrance exams like NATA for admission to BArch courses. The mode of study at BU is full-time and part-time (classroom). The university offers more than a hundred courses at UG, PG and PhD levels through 18 schools and four institutes. The courses are offered in multiple streams like Management, Engineering, Science, Architecture, etc. Apart from the regular courses,BIHER Onlinecourses.

Candidates seeking admission atBharath University coursesmust meet the course-specific eligibility criteria.Bharath Institute of Higher Education and Research course admissionsare based on entrance exam scores.The basic eligibility for Bharath University UG course admissions is that the candidate must have passed class 12 and for PG courses, the candidates must have a bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline. Further,Bharath University course admissions are based on various entrance exam scores such asNEET, NEET SS, NEET PG etc as per respective courses. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularBharath University courses:

Bharath University course admission processis a multi-step process. The University offers admission to various courses at UG and PG level based on merit or entrance exam. Candidates willing to secure a seat must meet the Bharath University course eligibility criteria and then follow the steps mentioned below:
Bharath University Application Process:

Bharath University application processis conducted online on itsofficial website. The candidate needs to apply for their desired course and pay the required Bharath University application fee to confirm their submission.
Bharath University Selection Rounds:

The University shortlists candidates either based on merit in the qualifying exam or through the entrance exam. Bharath University conducts its engineering entrance examBEEE. Apart from BEEE, the university acceptsNEETfor admission to the MBBS programme.
Bharath University Final Admission:
After shortlisting candidates, Bharath University makes final admission offers. Selected candidates need to pay the admission confirmation fee to secure their seat at the University.

college_info.intro:
Amity Global Business School, Mumbai offers 2 prominent programs, that are aligned as per international Business Management norms. The UG program is the integrated Graduate Program in Business Administration + Bachelor of Business Administration (GPBA+BBA).
The course aligns students with an excellent skillset to be equipped for a global Management strategy. The PG program offered is the sought-after Post Graduate Program in Management + Master of Business Administration (PGPM+MBA). Both the courses are offered in multiple specializations.

placements.overview:
AGBS Chennai admission is open for 2026 admissions. Students can apply for the desired course online through the official website or offline, according to their convenience.

Amity Global Business School (AGBS), Mumbai is an eminent B-School located in Malad West, Mumbai. The institute offers integrated UG, and integrated PG courses that are globally-aligned and accepted internationally. Also known as AGBS Mumbai, the institute is part of a wide network of AGBS B-Schools that are spread across the nation under the ambit of Amity University. AGBS Mumbai was founded in 2009.

AGBS Mumbai has been consistently ranked as one of the leading Business Schools in India, and provides the popular programs of GPBA+BBA (UG) and PGPM+MBA (PG). The institute provides excellent placement opportunities with 98% placements and highest packages reaching up to INR 23 LPA. Amity Global Business School, Mumbai provides state-of-the-art infrastructural facilities.

reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely an amazing college.

review_content.Placements: 75% students were placed through college, which is quite amazing. The highest package was 5 LPA; we were actually expecting 3 LPA to be the start-up but it was 5 LPA. reviews.review_heading: Shaping the future of CEOs.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are so good at the institute having free Wi-Fi, best classrooms with projectors, and library full of the latest and new editions of books. Every year, they conduct a college sports event where all students participate and show their hidden talents to the world.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely an amazing college.
reviews.review_text:
Amazing from the library to the classroom. 
The canteen food is completely hygienic. 
My hostel had all the facilities a student would require and could make you feel like home, from the caring to the cleanliness.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a good experience of learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. There are a few things within the classroom that could be improved. But the college is trying their best to improve things, one by one. The canteen provides basic options of a sandwich, a few rolls, biscuits, wafers and juices. There are lunch specials like fried rice and pav bhaji on some days too.

reviews.review_heading: Amity has made me understand the unique way of learning.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms in our college are well structured. We have a seminar hall which is used to conduct events such as guest speaking and other cultural events which is a very effective way one can use its hall. The food served in the canteen is good and hygienic. It has very good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Very helpful faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well designed and developed. The classrooms and Library are updated and maintained as well. The mess area is very clean and hygiene. Sports event are organised at a large scale where students get an opportunity to explore their talent.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life in AGBS is amazing.
reviews.review_text: Our college has all the basic infrastructure facilities. It has a computer lab, library, canteen and a small indoor games area. Classrooms are well furnished, which attracts the students most. One flaw in this college is the food served in the canteen. Medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are good. International teaching standards. High-quality infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good library facility to students, where they can refer and issue book related to management. The college does not provide hostel facilities but helps students coming from other places to get places to stay. There is a good canteen, where students can get their lunch or snacks.

They also conduct AML (Amity Mumbai League) which is a sports event conducted for students. This sports event is full of fun.

reviews.review_heading: Outside faculty members are awesome.
reviews.review_text: No Wi-Fi, no proper AC, no medical facilities no sports and games. Classroom are okay. Food is expensive and it is the worst in taste. Shortage of classroom. Canteen is pathetic. All windowa are closed, no AC and fan in canteen. Wi-Fi are meant to be just for faculty only.

reviews.review_heading: The placements and the faculty are very bad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very poor. There is a very less space because the college only occupies one floor in the building and it's hard to accomodate so many students during announcements. Only Junk food is sold in the canteen. Rats are roaming above the ceiling and dustbins. They don't give access to Wi-Fi. They had promised on providing computers but never actually gave us one. We had to get our own. Who puts a computer with games like Counter-Strike in a library? At least I never would. Walls a...

reviews.review_heading: AGBS, MUMBAI. A place where you go to learn, develop, believe & make memories.
reviews.review_text: Situated on the 4th floor, behind Toyota showroom. The campus is small but amazing. You have a cafeteria wherein you have carrom boards and a table tennis area for your refreshment. You have an amazing library where you have loads of books. Books related to finance, accounting, IT, global history, politics, etc. are available.

reviews.review_heading: AGBS Mumbai has set an example for other colleges. Absolutely had the best 5 years of my life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at Amity is simply the best. All the classrooms are highly equipped with latest amenities. Every classroom has a projector, a screen, speakers, Wi-Fi connection, etc. The library, the canteen, the play area, etc everything is perfect. The entire campus is under CCTV coverage.

Step 3: Final Seat Allotment

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by IMS Law CollegeReviewed on 30 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with curriculum activities, but definitely needs an upgrade in infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is okay, not too much of an area according to the fee they take, but every facility is provided. The classrooms are spacious, there are 2 libraries with strong Wi-Fi connection, and there are cultural clubs, sports club, canteen, medical, and everything you'll need.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by IMS Law CollegeReviewed on 20 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college has good faculty, amazing sports section, average infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I would say that the infrastructure of the college is pretty average, but the facilities, on the other hand, are very amazing. Every class and building has access to Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a library, an arts room, a music room, and a games room as well. Especially in the hostel, the food is very clean, hygienic, and tasty. It also consists of a medical room, a separate badminton and sports court, as well as a library.

reviews.review_heading: A career focused college with strong placements and decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure were available in my course. It provided high-speed internet Wi-Fi, computer labs, digital library, smart classrooms, experienced faculty members, project and research support, placement and career cell. Hostal facilities provided well-furnished rooms (single/double/triple sharing), with beds, study tables, fans, bulbs, and plug points. It provided 24X7 electricity with backup, hot water, RO drinking water, and refrigerators on each floor.

reviews.review_heading: The college is worth the money paid.
reviews.review_text: I have just rated a four stars because this college does not seem to be good. After all, students get attracted first of all through the college infrastructure and its environment but in IMS Noida there were no such facilities provided at the time of our batch. After we had passed out several changes had been made for the new arrivals.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied by the placements department.
reviews.review_text: During admission they showed classrooms that had ACs and projectors, but after few months they shifted us to such a bad class and this happens with every batch. They did not even used ACs in such a humid temperature, this was the complain of all the students and even faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities are good at an affordable price.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is modern and well-equipped according to the needs of students. The campus is spread over a decent area with modern classrooms, a seminar hall, and lecture theatres equipped with projectors and PA systems. Hostel accommodations are of quality, but availability may vary.

reviews.review_heading: College is good, but don’t take admission for your betterment.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good; there is Wi-Fi in every classroom and projectors also. There are two libraries in the college. In the library, there is a full Wi-Fi zone. The hostels are the best, the food in the hostel is good quality, and the canteen is very good. It's a hill place for the students where all the required things are available.

reviews.review_heading: Unplugged diary of IMS Noida.
reviews.review_text: If we talk about the facilities Wi-Fi access was very good on campus. Lab was also better and useful where as library had a good number of journals and books. Hostel was not available for boys, that was available only for girls on campus. Hostel provided a better accommodation for girls. Food quality was also good as per girls review. Sports facilities were available on campus but the ground was short.

reviews.review_heading: Review of every possible thing about this college in short.
reviews.review_text: The faculty members are good and very interactive and highly skilled, and the whole campus has good Wi-Fi coverage and labs have good systems having good CPUs (i5 12th-generation processors), which is good for every possible task in BCA. The sports facilities are good, including different clubs having skilled mentors, and have a clean ground suitable for football.

reviews.review_heading: In our college, placements reviews are too good, and infrastructure is also good.
reviews.review_text: Best facilities like labs, classrooms, and infrastructure are available for the BBA course. The quality of food is very good, and medical facilities are also best in our hostel. Mess and canteen facilities are too good for all students and staff. Wi-Fi and library are also available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: IMS NOIDA, best college for BCA.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but one thing I don't like is that there is no AC in the BCA rooms. AC is available only for law and BBA students, not for BCA. Hostel food and cleanliness are good, as I have heard, but I didn't opt for the hostel, though a friend who opted for it shared this feedback.

reviews.review_heading: IMS Noida is the best. Review is okay!
reviews.review_text: No private rooms are provided. The food is okay, but the prices are, I guess, too high for such a rate. Classrooms and library facilities are good. Canteen food is amazing; I won't lie. Games, dance, singing, radio station— there are so many other activities .

reviews.review_heading: College is good and infrastructure is also good. Faculty of this college is good.
reviews.review_text:
To be honest, I'm not happy with the facilities of my course because they don't provide us air conditioners. The faculty is very good and teachers are very cooperative.
I don't know about the hostel but there is a decent canteen and the food quality is not very good or very bad. Food facilities are also good but you won't be able to play basketball there.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by IMS Law CollegeReviewed on 11 Oct 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and good colleges for management and law
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in every floor, and the hostel is also available. The canteens are small, but the food is so tasty that there are two canteens. The sports room is also available in the college. There are two libraries for law and management students. Overall, good infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty of the college is good, but the placement scenario is not good for students.
reviews.review_text: The quality of food in the canteen was average. The infrastructure of the college was also not that good. Wi-Fi was not available for the students; that's for the teachers only. The facilities for games was also not good; the teachers were absent for 2-3 days and the students also don't care about the games if the teacher doesn't come.

placements.overview:
Amity University, Raipur admissions 2026 are currently open! Interested students can visit the official website and apply online for their favorite course.

Amity University Raipur is a private university established in 2014. It is a part of Amity University, Uttar Pradesh which is a 20-year-old, popular leading education group in India. Amity University Raipur Chhattisgarh currently has over 1.50 lakh students pursuing 250 programmes in all the campuses in India and abroad. Amity University Raipur Chhatisgarh is recognised by the UGC and approved by the BCI and the Council of Architecture (COA).

Amity Raipur courses are offered to students at UG, PG, and PhD levels in streams, including Engineering, Architecture, Design, Management, Commerce and others. BTech and MBA are the popular programmes. Amity University Raipur admission is based on merit and entrance exams. The university accepts national entrance exams such as JEE Main, CUET UG, CAT, MAT, GMAT, NMAT, and other exams.

review_summary.college_name: Amity University Raipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) (Honours/ Research) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the campus is good.

content.Placements: The BBA course sees around 70 percent placements and roles, mainly in sales, business development, and HR. 80 percent of the students have secured internships in finance, marketing, and HR. Companies like Flipkart, Renault, etc., hire students for major roles like sales, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is totally good for the BBA and hostel, and the facilities provided are also good. Facilities in the hostel have been improved and now they take proper care of everything. There are useless restrictions that are imposed on students that need to be stopped.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The university has a great performance in Chhattisgarh.

content.Placements: Approximately 75% of students are placed at the university every year. The highest package goes across 30 LPA, and the lowest package goes across 8 LPA. The university provides different courses for the students to make their future bright as well, and the CRC department of the university is helpful for the students.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities at the university are excellent, like unlimited Wi-Fi, good furniture, an AC dining hall, a green campus, and good infrastructure. The classroom has ACs. There is a cleanliness on the campus, and it has a ragging-free atmosphere, is under CCTV surveillance, and provides medical facilities, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication (Honours/ Research) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great learning and experience from Amity.

content.Placements: The placements provided at Amity are good. Top media houses visited the campus for placement. The package ranges from 4-7 LPA. Many students from my batch went for higher education. Internship opportunities are provided to the students based on their interests and skills.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure provided for learning is excellent. The studio is equipped with all the necessary equipment for our learning. The classrooms have Wi-Fi. The library has books for all departments. It has computers for e-learning where students can access journals. The hostel facility is good. They provide two sharing rooms. There are 3 hostels currently. There are common rooms, game rooms, and a dance room for students' engagement. The mess area is quite big, accommodation for the students. The food provided is to suits everyone's taste. The medical staff is available for the students' help.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Well-structured curriculum and good placements.

content.Placements: In my batch out of the strength of 79 students, almost 40 percent of students got an on-campus placement with the highest offer of 19 LPA and an average of 5 LPA. 30 percent of students went for higher education. Top roles offered in our courses include Software Developer, Data Analyst, Software Engineer, etc. Recruiting companies include LearningRoutes, PlanetSpark, QSpiders, IBM, Genpact, and more.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, our college has a good infrastructure having all the required labs, with high-speed internet connections available for all the students. Our college has a wide range of books available in high-class libraries and has a vast collection of books, research papers, and digital resources. The hostel facilities are designed for our comfort and convenience, offering both AC and non-AC rooms with essential amenities like Wi-Fi, Laundry, and security.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B.(Hons.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Insight of Amity University Raipur.

content.Placements: My batch in total has 30 students. As we are freshers, we know about our seniors who have been placed in huge companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Google, etc. The average package is 500,000 per year, and the highest goes up to 2,500,000 or something. The lowest can be 200,000 per year to start, then it can increase according to your performance in the future.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure provided by the college is top-notch. The library has vast resources, fully equipped sports facilities, and well-maintained classrooms, making it a conducive environment for learning and recreation. The campus design, with its modern amenities and green spaces, ensures a balance between study and relaxation.

reviews.review_heading: Insight of Amity University Raipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided by the college is top-notch. The library has vast resources, fully equipped sports facilities, and well-maintained classrooms, making it a conducive environment for learning and recreation. The campus design, with its modern amenities and green spaces, ensures a balance between study and relaxation.

reviews.review_heading: Details of Amity University, Raipur.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college is well-furnished with projectors and air-conditioned classrooms. In hostel, there are 3 rooms for 6 students sharing, one washroom and one bathroom. reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure at this college is good. It has many facilities, including Wi-Fi, a library, and an auditorium. The quality and quantity of the food are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Very pleasant campus with all the facilities available.
reviews.review_text: As being a biotechnology student, we are provided with very good lab facilities with all the necessities available! Lab hours are also scheduled in a very efficient manner! reviews.review_heading: Good teaching faculty and good placements.

reviews.review_heading: Great facilities, and the campus is so good.
reviews.review_text: The college has great infrastructure with a good campus building, and there are washrooms and a parking area. The college offers facilities like free Wi-Fi, good classrooms, and well-equipped labs. The library is useful to students, and the hostels and mess are good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, experience during studies was good.
reviews.review_text: Transportation, air-conditioned classrooms, a mess, and a canteen were the facilities, and infrastructure was newly built. The campus was small and far from the city. The quality of the food was not good. Students got food poisoning due to the bad and unhealthy food. Sports and games competitions used to take place, like badminton and basketball, majorly.

reviews.review_heading: Nice campus and has great facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities for students. The facilities provided are separate hostels for boys and girls with free Wi-Fi, good classrooms, labs and a well-stocked library. The mess is hygienic. The infrastructure is good with proper buildings and a pleasant environment.

reviews.review_heading: A brief information about Amity University, Raipur.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and a library are available and the campus is full of AC. Everything is good, but the quality of the food is the worst. We have a canteen, but most of the time it won't have food to buy, and outside food is not allowed on campus, even if it is homely food.

reviews.review_text: There are beautiful classrooms on our campus, with windows and A.C. All students are allowed to access free Wi-Fi. Overall, the infrastructure of the campus is very good. The hostel also has good infrastructure, providing facilities 24/7.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Very happy with my college, reasonable fees and excellent commited faculties good infrastructure

content.Placements: The first year students do not have any placements. Only the second year students have placements. The placements have not been complete. The companies are still recruiting only. Till now, about 25 percent of the students have been placed. The highest package is Rs 4.9 Lacs per year which is about 45000 per month. The lowest package is Rs 15000 per month and average package is Rs 30000 per month. About 30 companies have came to our college. Roles such as Marketing head, Assistant Manager, Sales head where given. The internship process is still going on. It is not fully completed. Yes, there is a placement cell. It is very efficient. They sort the companies and selected students are given chance according to the companies requirements. They inform different placement locations in other colleges and very effective in training the students for placement. Our college is proving special Training for the first year students for placements.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: This college is the perfect choice for quality education.

content.Placements: The institution offers great placement opportunities for students. The salary package offered is very high. More than 80% of the students got placed through campus placements. Some others chose to be entrepreneurs, and some took up their family business. Roles offered may vary according to the specialisation of students, but the managerial profile was offered mostly. The placement cell works wholeheartedly to provide the best opportunities for students.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a state-of-the-art infrastructure with no compromise on facilities provided to students. Internet facilities are available in the college and hostels. Smart class facilities are provided. World-class theatre classrooms are provided with a plug-and-play facility for each student, and they are Wi-Fi and LAN enabled. The LCD screen, E-Board and audio systems are also provided. The college has a library with innumerate online and offline resources. Food provided in the canteen is very good. Hostel rooms are well-equipped.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the college because of high quality teaching and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are quite good. The placement cell in our campus is a boon to the college. More than 90% of the students were placed last year. Placement season for the current batch has already started. The highest salary package offered until now is 8 LPA. The college offers many pre-placement offers through internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is the best. Our college provides free Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms look like amphitheatres with the best working environment. Students can interact with faculty members through transition spaces. The college has an excellent library which offers educational as well as other books, and the library can be accessed at any time. Our college encourages sports and games. We have sports clubs, cultural clubs, etc., to conduct activities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: A place that makes students corporate ready.

content.Placements: A lot of companies are visiting the college offering equal chances for the students who are interested in finance, marketing and operations. Almost 70% of the students are getting placed in companies like Federal Bank, HDFC Bank, Naukri.Com, HDFC AMC, E&Y, South Indian Bank and Catholic Syrian Bank. The highest salary package offered is 9.60 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 3.50 LPA. Almost 45% of the students got placed in the companies they have done internships in. There is a placement team which guides students in preparing for aptitude and interviews.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: An excellent campus for building your career.

content.Placements: The college has an excellent and effective placement cell. Their active work has led to a very good placement rate in the past years. I am a student of the 2017-2019 batch. I am well satisfied with the placements provided by the college till now.
content.Infrastructure: The college has an excellent and pleasing infrastructure. It is well- maintained and improved. The infrastructure is very adaptive for students, and the campus is peaceful. The college is located in a hilly area which is far away from the city. This location gives a great positive vibe to the campus.

Saintgits Institute of Management's admission process is a three-step process starting with the SIM application process and ending with the final admission offer. Admission to SIM MBA course is done based on the candidate's performance in the national-level entrance exam. The institute accepts CAT/ CMAT/ KMAT to shortlist candidates for further rounds of selection. The stepwise SIM admission process is mentioned below:
Step 1: SIM Application Process

Eligible candidates need to apply for their desired SIM course through its official website. Apart from this, the candidates also need to apply separately for the entrance exam accepted by SIM to shortlist candidates. Aspirants must complete the application process before the deadline as mentioned on the SIM official website.
Step 2: SIM Selection Rounds

After receiving applications from the candidates, the institute shortlists students for further rounds of selection which includes the GDPI round. Saintgits Institute of Management also gives relevant weightage to work experience during the selection process. For PhD course admission, candidates must sit and appear for Institute Entry Test or Personal Interview.
Step 3: SIM Final Admission Offer
The final admission offers are given to those who perform extremely well in all the selection rounds. Selected candidates need to paySaintgits Institute of Management feesto secure their seats.
