review_summary.college_name: Quantum University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Quantum University.

content.Placements: Quantum holds a record of more than 85 percent of the batch students getting placed through campus placements, and in our course, it is 90 percent. The highest package offered is 7 LPA for BPT, and the average package ranges from 3-4 LPA. The college has tie-ups with many private hospitals nearby in Dehradun, Haridwar, and Rishikesh.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure in Quantum University is good, according to the fees and all. Buildings are well furnished. Labs are well-equipped, and classrooms are well-maintained. Libraries are well updated with books. Hostels are also quite good. It also provides a mess, laundry, gym, Wi-Fi, and many sports facilities in the hostel. Food is quite good in taste and full of variety.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Quantum is the best choice I have ever made.

content.Placements: I am still pursuing the course here, but more than 85 percent of the batch gets placement through campus placement. The highest package was 7 LPA last year, and the average was 4 LPA. Many private hospital recruit from our college. The students, after getting placed in many hospitals, chose their careers according to their preferences.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure, facilities, such as buildings, labs, and classrooms are very well maintained and well-equipped with the latest updates. Hostel is offered with many facilities like mess, gym, laundry, Wi-Fi, and many sports facilities. The mess is very hygienic and clean, and the food is so good.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Business intelligence and Analytics Collaboration with Samartrix - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Quantum University is the best university in the Roorkee area.

content.Placements: The highest placement percentage is 85 percent, the maximum package is not more than 2.5 LPA, companies like Arvind Fashion, Tata Consultancy, Amardeep Design, Yacca, Pritam Pvt. Ltd., and Asian East West Pharma visit the campus, and I completed an Internshala online course in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics with 60 percent.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not available for students. Classrooms are good. Libraries are good, with books and a computer library. Every department has its own library. There is a quite good facility in the hostel. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is normal, and medical facilities are also good. Sports and games are not good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of Quantum University.

content.Placements: Quantum University was one of the best universities in Uttarakhand that provided good quality education with good placements every year. The placement percentage of Quantum University was above 80%. More than 70 companies visited the university every year for jobs. Many reputed companies were Tata, HCL, and TCS.
content.Infrastructure: Quantum University provided good hostel facility. In this facility, they provided food, lodging, laundry, Wi-Fi, gym, and 24-hour security. University also provided good sports facility. University did not charge any extra amount for this. University provided interdisciplinary education.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the BCA course.

content.Placements: 70-80 percent of students got placed. According to me, 50 percent of students got placements. The average package ranges from 2.5-3 LPA. Top roles offered are software developer, QA analyst, SEO, etc. Companies like TCS visit the pool placements. Not many IT companies visit, but many sales companies give good placements.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi works relatively slowly, but new 5G routers are now being installed in hostel labs and on the campus for faster speeds. There are two libraries in the college. The old one is a little bit bigger than the new library. It has sufficient books, but the new one has business-related books.

faqs.question: In which university it is easy to get admissions into BCom course among Motherhood University and Quantum University?
faqs.answer: For admissions to the BCom course at  Motherhood University and Quantum University, they accept candidates' Class 12 scores and release the merit after evaluating the scores. However, there is only one difference between the admission process of the BCom course, i.e., Quantum University also accepts the relevant CUET-UG scores for admissions to BCom courses. On the other hand, acceptance of CUET scores for admission to BCom at Motherhood University is not explicitly mentioned on the official web

faqs.question: What is the process to apply offline for BCom course at Quantum University?
faqs.answer: Applying offline for BCom courses at Quantum University is stated as a one-to-one application process. For the offline application process, students can register themselves for admission to Quantum University by visiting the campus. In addition, candidates can visit any of the campus admissions offices along with an application fee in the form of a bank DD of INR 1,200. The amount can be paid in the name of "Quantum University" payable at Dehradun.

faqs.question: Is Mathematics compulsory for admission to B.Com course at Quantum University?
faqs.answer: No, Mathematics subject is not compulsory for admission to the BCom & BCom (Hons.) course at Quantum University. The eligibility requirements that are necessary for a BCom course are that candidates must complete their Class 12 from any recognised board of Education from any stream and with a minimum aggregate of 50%. Additionally, the university takes admissions on the basis of candidates' achieved scores in their Class 12/ CUET-UG.

faqs.question: What is CUET UG admit card 2025 release date?
faqs.answer: CUET UG 2025 admit card will be released four days prior to the each exam date. CUET UG 2025 exam will be scheduled between May 13 and June 03, 2025 in multiple sessions. NTA will issue the CUET UG 2025 admit card for each day separately. Registered candidates will be issued the CUET admit card 2025 as per their schedule and CUET subject chosen.To download the CUET UG 2025 admit card, candidates must visit the official website of CUET UG 2025- cuet.nta.nic.in and enter their login details to download the hall ticket. faqs.question: What is the placement package offered at Quantum University? Does it justify the ROI?
faqs.answer: The official website of the University includes the highest and average packages. To know the ROI, let's first look at the fee structure of the University. The total fee for BTech generally ranges between INR 4.62 lakh and INR 6.42 lakh. Now, the average package offered to the 2025 passing out batch was INR 7.20 LPA which is above the highest expected fee. Thus, it indicates that students can easily meet the ROI. The table below depicts the Quantum University placement packages: Particulars Placement Statistics (2025) Highest package INR 33.50 LPA Average package INR 7.20 LPA NOTE: The above details are fetched from the official website, however, the placement year is not mentioned. Hence, considered it for 2025.

faqs.question: Are there any government job opportunities available after completing BSc courses from Quantum University?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are various government job opportunities after completing BSc courses from Quantum University. Government jobs remain in high demand due to various benefits, including job security, competitive pay, tax benefits, and more. Students with a bachelor's degree in Science can apply for many different jobs in the public sector. Moreover, studying a course like BSc improves a candidate's technical knowledge and analytical skills, which is necessary to crack government exams. Students with Science degrees can take government exams to seek research-based job opportunities at national institutes and laboratories. reviews.review_heading: Review of Quantum University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in Quantum University is good, according to the fees and all. Buildings are well furnished. Labs are well-equipped, and classrooms are well-maintained. Libraries are well updated with books. Hostels are also quite good. It also provides a mess, laundry, gym, Wi-Fi, and many sports facilities in the hostel. Food is quite good in taste and full of variety.

reviews.review_heading: Quantum is the best choice I have ever made.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure, facilities, such as buildings, labs, and classrooms are very well maintained and well-equipped with the latest updates. Hostel is offered with many facilities like mess, gym, laundry, Wi-Fi, and many sports facilities. The mess is very hygienic and clean, and the food is so good.

reviews.review_heading: Quantum University is the best university in the Roorkee area.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available for students. Classrooms are good. Libraries are good, with books and a computer library. Every department has its own library. There is a quite good facility in the hostel. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is normal, and medical facilities are also good. Sports and games are not good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Quantum University.
reviews.review_text: Quantum University provided good hostel facility. In this facility, they provided food, lodging, laundry, Wi-Fi, gym, and 24-hour security. University also provided good sports facility. University did not charge any extra amount for this. University provided interdisciplinary education.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the BCA course.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi works relatively slowly, but new 5G routers are now being installed in hostel labs and on the campus for faster speeds. There are two libraries in the college. The old one is a little bit bigger than the new library. It has sufficient books, but the new one has business-related books.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Quantum School of Health Sciences (Admission Office)
reviews.review_heading: Life at Quantum University Roorkee is full of new experiences and lessons.
reviews.review_text: Quantum provides very nice facilities and a good infrastructure on the campus. The location and surroundings are peaceful and beautiful. All the facilities like Wi-Fi, classrooms, and a library are well-furnished and maintained with well-equipped labs. The mess and canteen of the college are one of the best places where I feel like a second home. Everything is just so good, clean, and pure in every aspect.

reviews.review_heading: Quantum University review.
reviews.review_text: In the name of facilities and infrastructure, my college is not upto the mark in my course/department. They don't provide Wi-Fi, and there are no fixed classrooms in my course. The library is quite good. Hostel facilities are average. Sports and games are limited.

reviews.review_heading: This is a good university because it provides me with good memories, good placement, and good friend
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is also very good. The Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library are also available. Every facility is good. The mess facilities are also available, and the food is good in the mess.

reviews.review_heading: Quantum University is one of the best universities.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is the most memorable part of college life for the students. At Quantum, world class hostels are not just about buildings, but are the core of every culture. Providing a very secure and fun filled environment that makes the student feel quite at home.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with my decision of choosing Quantum.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped. Classrooms are fully furnished, well-equipped, and libraries are very well maintained. In hostels, rooms are well furnished with a separate bed, table, chair, cupboard, and fan too. Hostel food is quite good in taste, and the menu is full of variety.

reviews.review_heading: Quantum University offers knowledge and skills.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure was quite good. Along with a hygienic environment. The college provided all facilities such as a library, Wi-Fi, labs, and a well-structured building. A great cafeteria for both students and teachers. The food quality was also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Quantum University is the best private university.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure included furnished rooms such as single and double sharing. Basic facilities like beds, study tables, and cupboards were provided. Along with common facilities. Many hostels also offered security, laundry services, and medical facilities. Each room typically had a bed, a mattress, a study table, and other necessary furniture. Everything was good, and Quantum University was very good. Facilities of the college were great.

reviews.review_heading: Learning experience in Quantum.
reviews.review_text: Quantum University has a library included in the fee structure. They issue a card for the library, and you can take the books you want using that card. They also provide hostel facilities, but I didn’t opt for that as I am a local person from Saharanpur, so I used to commute daily, which was more cost-effective for me.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Quantum University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Quantum University in my course B.Tech (hons) cybersecurity is not good at all. There is no Wi-Fi service and even in a training session which is a collaboration with Quick Heal academy. If we work on the system they told us to take your laptop.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my course in Quantum University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Quantum University is not up to the mark. And for our course it provides average facilities of lab and Wi-Fi. If we want to work in college systems, they tell us to take our laptop to do this kind of work. And their systems run very slow.

placements.overview:
REVA University Bengaluru was established in 2012 and is located in Bangalore, Kolkata. It is a state private university which was established in the state of Karnataka under the Goverment of Karnataka Act No. 13 and is one of the leading universities to offer technology-based education to students and is recognised by UGC as well as approved by the AICTE. REVA Bangalore has been accredited by national bodies such as the NBA and NAAC with an A+ grade. Further, the university has a sprawling campus of over 43 acres with modern facilities installed all around.

Students of UG, PG, PhD, certificate and diploma levels are offered education through the 30+ schools of study at REVA University. reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Robotics and Automation - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure and facilities. Faculty members are quite helpful.

review_content.Placements: As of a batch of 25, 100 percent of students get placed. The lowest package offered is around 3.2 LPA, and the highest package offered is 30 LPA in the B.Tech. in Robotics and Automation batch. The top recruiting companies for our course are ABB and Bosch. 75 percent of students got internships. Roles offered are robotics designer, engineer, and software developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library is open till midnight for studies. The hostel experience is above average. Medical facilities are provided on campus. It also has indoor and outdoor sports. The mess food can be eaten, and weekly they serve non-veg food thrice, which is generally nice. Labs are quite helpful.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things and Cyber Security including Block Chain Technology) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure, decent staff, and good placement.

review_content.Placements: Around 70 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 40 LPA and the average is around 6 LPA. Around 60 percent of students got internships from TCS, Wipro, Infosys. Top roles offered are software developer, data analyst, cloud engineer, system engineer. Overall, placement is good this year (2024–2025).
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostels are well maintained and have Wi-Fi. Food is decent. Medical facilities are available inside the campus, but there is no CCTV in classrooms. Labs are well-equipped, and all types of instruments are available. Classrooms are very well-equipped with smart boards.

reviews_list.batch_info: Discontinued(Jan-2023)- B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things) - Batch of 2029

individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and facilities. Faculty members are quite helpful.

content.Placements: As of a batch of 25, 100 percent of students get placed. The lowest package offered is around 3.2 LPA, and the highest package offered is 30 LPA in the B.Tech. in Robotics and Automation batch. content.Infrastructure: The library is open till midnight for studies. The hostel experience is above average. Medical facilities are provided on campus. It also has indoor and outdoor sports. The mess food can be eaten, and weekly they serve non-veg food thrice, which is generally nice. Labs are quite helpful.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things and Cyber Security including Block Chain Technology) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, decent staff, and good placement.

content.Placements: Around 70 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 40 LPA and the average is around 6 LPA. Around 60 percent of students got internships from TCS, Wipro, Infosys. Top roles offered are software developer, data analyst, cloud engineer, system engineer. Overall, placement is good this year (2024–2025).

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued(Jan-2023)- B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Decent placements, good student life.

content.Infrastructure: Very good quality food is available in the food court, good medical facilities with emergency services, a large sports ground with lots of games, Wi-Fi is pretty fast for normal work with a wireless network around 100 Mbps and wired labs around 1 Gbps, a massive library with all relevant materials which are also uploaded online and can be accessed through their website, and smart classrooms with smartboards, TV, projector, and a green board.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with this college.

individual_reviews.title: Good placements and a huge campus.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and facilities. Faculty members are quite helpful.
reviews.review_text: The library is open till midnight for studies. The hostel experience is above average. Medical facilities are provided on campus. It also has indoor and outdoor sports. The mess food can be eaten, and weekly they serve non-veg food thrice, which is generally nice. Labs are quite helpful.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, decent staff, and good placement.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are well maintained and have Wi-Fi. Food is decent. Medical facilities are available inside the campus, but there is no CCTV in classrooms. Labs are well-equipped, and all types of instruments are available. Classrooms are very well-equipped with smart boards.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements, good student life.
reviews.review_text: Very good quality food is available in the food court, good medical facilities with emergency services, a large sports ground with lots of games, Wi-Fi is pretty fast for normal work with a wireless network around 100 Mbps and wired labs around 1 Gbps, a massive library with all relevant materials which are also uploaded online and can be accessed through their website, and smart classrooms with smartboards, TV, projector, and a green board.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very good. The food court is also nice. We get all types of food items there. Even in our block, we have nice canteens where we can get snacks. Our college has many stalls like Maggi Point, Panchami Sagar, Nandini Cafe, and others.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and a huge campus.
reviews.review_text: Our college has speed Wi-Fi, good food. There are mess, canteens and quality food is served. There is also a medical room for treatment of fever for temporary use, there is a huge ground where people play around and its kind of a park. There are different games played like athletics, basketball, kabaddi and some other sports.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: There is great infrastructure in Reva University, there is a 24/7 Wi-Fi facility, labs, and classrooms are great, and the library is so big, and all books are available. For hostelers, it is available up to midnight, and hostel and mess food is also hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure and a good crowd.
reviews.review_text: There are enough facilities in our hostel, including Wi-Fi, 24/7 hot water, and AC. The hostel food is good, with three meals and evening snacks. Each department has a separate library. There is also a central library with Wi-Fi. It is one of the best campuses in Bangalore. Along with facilities like a salon, novelty store, stationery and healthcare centre, food court, indoor sports arena, and fitness centre.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good college for the MBA course.
reviews.review_text: The campus is stunning and has everything we could possibly need. In addition to having large classrooms, labs, Wi-Fi, and libraries. The hostel is, to be honest, subpar and more costly than the college tuition. It has mediocre amenities, and the cuisine is undoubtedly a concern.

reviews.review_heading: Good college that provides various opportunities.
reviews.review_text: We get clean and neat washrooms, water facilities, and hygienic food. Food in hostels is repetitive as they have fixed a timetable for each day. Sports and games are optional and depend on personal preference. Hostel maintenance is very good and acceptable.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities, and we can expect our future here.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like computer labs, Wi-Fi & Internet, library, resource center, seminar halls & auditorium, well-maintained indoor and outdoor door games, on-campus medical centre, trained medical staff, nutritionists, hygienic food, and spacious and well-maintained rooms are available.

reviews.review_heading: College looks nice and beautiful campus, but placements are average for the fee we pay.

review_content.Placements: At Poornima University, placement opportunities vary by branch and individual performance. Generally, around 80 to 90 percent of students in popular branches like Computer Science and it get placed. The real placement numbers are very high for this college.
review_content.Infrastructure: My university offers modern infrastructure with well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, libraries, and sports facilities. It provides multiple courses like B.Tech, MBA, BVA, BBA, and design, along with a comfortable hostel featuring Wi-Fi, mess, sports, and many gardens.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely fantastic college and campus life to enjoy, and a perfect placement ratio.

review_content.Placements: The total number of students in B.Tech CSE is almost 1500. So a minimum of 100 to 120 students is selected. The highest package is 23 Lacs, the average package is 6-7 Lacs, and the lowest package is 2-3 Lacs. The above details are based on campus placement records. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, and HCL Technologies. In our college, internships start from the 6th semester, and mainly they are with local companies based in Jaipur. Almost 20 to 30% of students get internships, mainly for data analyst positions.
review_content.Infrastructure: In the first year, you explore various types of labs like electrical, electronics, CADD, Python, C lab, workshop, Physics lab, Chemistry lab, etc. From the second year, all your classes are held in lab rooms, and you get a personal desktop for all your classes. Hostel accommodation is very good; there are four hostels on our campus and also four hostels outside the campus. The mess is in a very large area on our campus, and there are two big mess halls with a capacity of a minimum of 800 students eating at a time. In a day, meals are served four times. Hostel life is very good on campus with free Wi-Fi, laundry, sports coaches, a gym, etc.

review_content.Infrastructure: The university provides Wi-Fi in each and every PC. Labs are excellent with AC and projectors. Classrooms are also very nice. Infrastructure is excellent. Food in hostel is average or above average we can say. Canteen is also there, sports facility is also available.

review_summary.college_name: Poornima University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. CSE (Full stack Development and Mobile Applications) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Modern campus, good learning.

content.Placements: At Poornima University, placement opportunities vary by branch and individual performance. Generally, around 80 to 90 percent of students in popular branches like Computer Science and it get placed. The real placement numbers are very high for this college.
content.Infrastructure: My university offers modern infrastructure with well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, libraries, and sports facilities. It provides multiple courses like B.Tech, MBA, BVA, BBA, and design, along with a comfortable hostel featuring Wi-Fi, mess, sports, and many gardens.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic college and campus life to enjoy, and a perfect placement ratio.

content.Placements: The total number of students in B.Tech CSE is almost 1500. So a minimum of 100 to 120 students is selected. The highest package is 23 Lacs, the average package is 6-7 Lacs, and the lowest package is 2-3 Lacs. The above details are based on campus placement records. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, and HCL Technologies. In our college, internships start from the 6th semester, and mainly they are with local companies based in Jaipur. Almost 20 to 30% of students get internships, mainly for data analyst positions.
content.Infrastructure: In the first year, you explore various types of labs like electrical, electronics, CADD, Python, C lab, workshop, Physics lab, Chemistry lab, etc. From the second year, all your classes are held in lab rooms, and you get a personal desktop for all your classes. Hostel accommodation is very good; there are four hostels on our campus and also four hostels outside the campus. The mess is in a very large area on our campus, and there are two big mess halls with a capacity of a minimum of 800 students eating at a time. In a day, meals are served four times. Hostel life is very good on campus with free Wi-Fi, laundry, sports coaches, a gym, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure facilities not satisfied with placements.

content.Placements: In my course 20 percent of students placed this year 2025. The highest package offered is 7LPA, the lowest package is 3.5LPA and the average package is 4LPA. Top recruiters are Fingertips, cellular technologies, and Robo MQ. 30 percent get internships. The Data Engineer roles course is very excellent but not for average students studywise.
content.Infrastructure: The university provides Wi-Fi in each and every PC. Labs are excellent with AC and projectors. Classrooms are also very nice. Infrastructure is excellent. Food in hostel is average or above average we can say. Canteen is also there, sports facility is also available.

individual_reviews.course: MCA in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Poornima University: Best college for placements and learning.

content.Placements: College provides lots of placement opportunities. In the year, lots of companies visit for campus drives. There is approximately a 50-60% placement percentage. The lowest packages depend on the company, they vary from 2.5 to 3.5 LPA, and the highest packages go up to 12-15 LPA. Many good companies come for placement, like Infosys, Josh, Datansh, Metacube, TCS, Dotsquare, and CIMET.
content.Infrastructure: The campus covers 32 acres and features cutting-edge ICT-enabled classrooms with Wi-Fi, LAN, and projectors. Seminar halls, auditoriums, and multimedia-equipped lecture rooms support conferences, workshops, and cultural events. The central library offers over 2400 volumes, a wide range of journals, and access to IEEE, DELNET, and other digital resources for engineering, management, architecture, and IT programs. Hostels are located on campus with secure access, providing accommodation for both boys and girls, including Himalaya Boys and Gargi Girls hostels. Hostel messes serve four daily meals under hygienic standards, alongside canteens offering vegetarian snacks.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Cyber Security) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It's all good and the best.

content.Placements: 60 to 80 per cent of students were placed most of the time in our college. The highest package is 30 LPA. The lowest is approximately 5.5. Top recruiting companies are IBM, Microsoft, Amazon, etc. 60 to 90 per cent of students were placed in internships. Top roles offered as a software intern, web developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: All good, but need to be better, and one thing which I also notice is that it's improving day by day. The management also saw that they needed to improve, so they implemented the procedure, and they are trying their best, but the quality in the hostel is, although good.

reviews.review_heading: Modern campus, good learning.
reviews.review_text: My university offers modern infrastructure with well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, libraries, and sports facilities. It provides multiple courses like B.Tech, MBA, BVA, BBA, and design, along with a comfortable hostel featuring Wi-Fi, mess, sports, and many gardens.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely fantastic college and campus life to enjoy, and a perfect placement ratio.
reviews.review_text: In the first year, you explore various types of labs like electrical, electronics, CADD, Python, C lab, workshop, Physics lab, Chemistry lab, etc. From the second year, all your classes are held in lab rooms, and you get a personal desktop for all your classes. Hostel accommodation is very good; there are four hostels on our campus and also four hostels outside the campus. The mess is in a very large area on our campus, and there are two big mess halls with a capacity of a minimum of 800 student...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure facilities not satisfied with placements.
reviews.review_text: The university provides Wi-Fi in each and every PC. Labs are excellent with AC and projectors. Classrooms are also very nice. Infrastructure is excellent. Food in hostel is average or above average we can say. Canteen is also there, sports facility is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Poornima University: Best college for placements and learning.
reviews.review_text: The campus covers 32 acres and features cutting-edge ICT-enabled classrooms with Wi-Fi, LAN, and projectors. Seminar halls, auditoriums, and multimedia-equipped lecture rooms support conferences, workshops, and cultural events. The central library offers over 2400 volumes, a wide range of journals, and access to IEEE, DELNET, and other digital resources for engineering, management, architecture, and IT programs. Hostels are located on campus with secure access, providing accommodation for both b...

reviews.review_heading: It's all good and the best.
reviews.review_text: All good, but need to be better, and one thing which I also notice is that it's improving day by day. The management also saw that they needed to improve, so they implemented the procedure, and they are trying their best, but the quality in the hostel is, although good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied, and good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are very good for my course. We have Wi-Fi connections, computer labs with good working systems, and a library with many reference and other books. The facilities in the hostel are good. As I am not from the hostel, I have heard from my friends that the food quality, sports and games, and medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements and supportive faculty, with vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course at Poornima University is quite modern, with a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, well-equipped computer labs, digital classrooms, and a central library that provides access to both books and e-resources. The hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms and 24/7 security.

reviews.review_heading: Good for the economic family.
reviews.review_text: Almost everything is available here; sometimes you find it sufficient, sometimes not. Almost, they have all the things that you want, not so, but so. They have a gym, football ground, American football ground, and central park; it's like a semi-event area, and currently, they are expanding their campus and infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The college is average and not worth as per the fee it charges.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities require significant improvement. Washrooms are hygienic and poorly maintained, which affects daily comfort and sanitation. Additionally, the Wi-Fi connectivity is unreliable, disrupting online activities and communication. The quality of food provided is also subpar and lacks consistency in taste and nutrition. Overall, these issues impact the living experience and need immediate attention.

reviews.review_heading: Poornima University - Just another tier 3 college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-notch. AC computer labs are assigned in place of traditional lecture halls. Every student has their own assigned PC. Talking about mess, food is satisfactory and quality and hygiene are maintained well. Sports exposure is great too, regular trials are conducted for university teams. Campus has courts for sports like tennis, pickleball, football, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with the environment and fests. Infrastructure development is a little annoying.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good, but the food in the mess is below average. However, overall it can be taken. I can't comment on hygiene, as the food is prepared elsewhere and then brought to the college. The classrooms are good, and the big library is pretty good.

reviews.review_heading: I opted for this college because of good and helpful faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Everything is perfect; the lab is well-equipped, with excellent air conditioning. The teachers are good, and the hostel is satisfactory, though the student population is a concern. All sports are available, such as cricket, tennis, basketball, etc., and I am happy to recommend them.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with my college as it has good faculty members and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available is good. Labs are too good with AC, and the new block and open stage stadium are being created.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with infrastructure and faculty. Great learning, average placements, and fun events.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are best for girls, especially since rooms are highly maintained. The washrooms are super clean. However, the boys' hostel is not the same as the girls, their washrooms are not in healthy condition. The mess food is average. The medical facilities are the best. They provide sports activities in the evening, which are open to hostellers and day scholars.

reviews.review_heading: Best private college within budget with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: There is a dedicated computer lab for the whole day for B.Tech, BCA, and MCA students. Classrooms are pretty decent, and the academic block is nice. There is a need for improvement in hostel food and infrastructure. There is serious development and construction ongoing to make a new academic building and hostel.

placements.overview:
The flagship programmes offered at Amity University Lucknow are BTech and MBA. The university offers these programmes to students at the UG and PG levels. These courses are offered to students for a duration of 4 and 2 years, respectively with a comprehensive curriculum. Amity University Lucknow courses strive to enhance the learning experience of students in order to prepare them for the industry.

Amity University Lucknow course admissions 2026 are open to all UG & PG courses. The university provides various programmes like BTech, BCA, BBA, BPharm, MBA, MCA, MSW, etc. as its popular courses. Amity University Lucknow course admissions are both merit and entrance-based. Various streams such as Engineering & Technology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Commerce, Management, Psychology, etc. are offered at Amity Lko.

Score cards for JEE Main, CAT, MAT, AMCAT, etc. are also accepted for admission to specific courses. Students can apply for admission by going to the official website. Students looking for admission to BTech program must have passed Class 12 from a recognised school and appear for the entrance exams. faqs.answer: A:    Candidates must complete graduation with Maths or graduation with Maths at Class 12 level/ BSc IT/ BCA to apply for MCA programme at Amity University Lucknow.Aspirants without Mathematics at Class 12 or graduation level, can still apply, by availing the option of a bridge course as per the norms of the university.

Additionally, candidates need to qualify English test for admission to MBA International. The shortlisted candidates are further called for a personal interview round. reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: I have pursued B.Com (Hons) from Amity University Lucknow; great campus, best college life.

review_content.Placements: The percent of students placed in this course is 90%. The highest package for this course was 4,50,000, and the lowest was 2,00,000. The top recruiting companies include Amazon, HCL, etc. 100% of students get internships from the course in HCL. Mostly, data analyst roles are available.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for the B.Com course include a library, classrooms, and Wi-Fi. The hostel quality was quite good, but it could be more well-structured, and the quality of food available in the mess was great in taste. Every weekend they have something special. Other than this, a canteen, medical store, and sports facilities were also available.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: BBA at Amity University, Lucknow: The best time of my life.

review_content.Placements: After BBA, placements are not that high that year. Around 35% of students got placed. The highest package for a graduation is 7.9 LPA. Companies like HDFC Bank, RBL Bank, and Mahindra Finance come to the campus. Sales executive roles are offered by recruiters. Also, the internship percentage is very high.
review_content.Infrastructure: At Amity University, you will always get top-class infrastructure available. Libraries, classes, labs, and even the corridors are so neat and clean, you always feel like being in the best college. The food in the mess is also served fresh and tasty. For every medical emergency, there is a van always available, and first aid is easily available. Every sport is played, like table tennis, lawn tennis, football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, the college is great. You can study and develop connections.

review_content.Placements: Around 50% students were placed, the highest package is 4.5 LPA, and it is in Quality Assurance. The top recruiting companies are Cipla, Alkem Laboratories, Pfizer, etc. Overall, the placement is average, but the placement cell tries its best to get every student placed in a good company with a good package.
review_content.Infrastructure: The Amity University Lucknow campus has impressive infrastructure that creates a perfect environment for learning and growing, the university provides both indoor and outdoor sports facilities. The playgrounds are well maintained, and the classrooms are great.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. (Hons.) in English - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Excellent infrastructure and facilities, but no scope for placements.

review_content.Placements: About 20-30 % students got placed in my course. Highest salary package was about 4 LPA, lowest salary package offered was 1.8 LPA, and average salary package was 2 LPA. There were many reputed companies that came for recruitment. No one got an internship in my course. Top roles that were offered were Marketing, Sales, and Telecommunications.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are many facilities, as Amity is known for its top-class infrastructure and facilities. Everything is there on campus, like Wi-Fi, auditorium, air-conditioned classrooms, sports grounds, library, etc. Quality of food is good, as there are many food outlets present on the campus. Hostels are also top-notch, and every facility is provided to students.

individual_reviews.title: I have pursued B.Com (Hons) from Amity University Lucknow; great campus, best college life.

content.Placements: The percent of students placed in this course is 90%. The highest package for this course was 4,50,000, and the lowest was 2,00,000. The top recruiting companies include Amazon, HCL, etc. 100% of students get internships from the course in HCL. Mostly, data analyst roles are available.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for the B.Com course include a library, classrooms, and Wi-Fi. The hostel quality was quite good, but it could be more well-structured, and the quality of food available in the mess was great in taste. Every weekend they have something special. Other than this, a canteen, medical store, and sports facilities were also available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: BBA at Amity University, Lucknow: The best time of my life.

content.Placements: After BBA, placements are not that high that year. Around 35% of students got placed. The highest package for a graduation is 7.9 LPA. Companies like HDFC Bank, RBL Bank, and Mahindra Finance come to the campus. Sales executive roles are offered by recruiters. Also, the internship percentage is very high.
content.Infrastructure: At Amity University, you will always get top-class infrastructure available. Libraries, classes, labs, and even the corridors are so neat and clean, you always feel like being in the best college. The food in the mess is also served fresh and tasty. For every medical emergency, there is a van always available, and first aid is easily available. Every sport is played, like table tennis, lawn tennis, football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the college is great. You can study and develop connections.

content.Infrastructure: The Amity University Lucknow campus has impressive infrastructure that creates a perfect environment for learning and growing, the university provides both indoor and outdoor sports facilities. The playgrounds are well maintained, and the classrooms are great.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in English - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Excellent infrastructure and facilities, but no scope for placements.

reviews.review_heading: I have pursued B.Com (Hons) from Amity University Lucknow; great campus, best college life.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for the B.Com course include a library, classrooms, and Wi-Fi. The hostel quality was quite good, but it could be more well-structured, and the quality of food available in the mess was great in taste. Every weekend they have something special. Other than this, a canteen, medical store, and sports facilities were also available.

reviews.review_heading: BBA at Amity University, Lucknow: The best time of my life.
reviews.review_text: At Amity University, you will always get top-class infrastructure available. Libraries, classes, labs, and even the corridors are so neat and clean, you always feel like being in the best college. The food in the mess is also served fresh and tasty. For every medical emergency, there is a van always available, and first aid is easily available. Every sport is played, like table tennis, lawn tennis, football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is great. You can study and develop connections.
reviews.review_text: The Amity University Lucknow campus has impressive infrastructure that creates a perfect environment for learning and growing, the university provides both indoor and outdoor sports facilities. The playgrounds are well maintained, and the classrooms are great.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent infrastructure and facilities, but no scope for placements.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities, as Amity is known for its top-class infrastructure and facilities. Everything is there on campus, like Wi-Fi, auditorium, air-conditioned classrooms, sports grounds, library, etc. Quality of food is good, as there are many food outlets present on the campus. Hostels are also top-notch, and every facility is provided to students.

reviews.review_heading: It is okay for a master's degree with no good placements. We get a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, and it was recently renovated. The college has good classrooms and an AC campus. The only issue is drinking water, and the rest is nice. Around the campus, we can get access to anything, so it is a highlight. A brilliant central library is a key structure with a clock tower above it.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: College can not provide a hostel I live in civil line Jabalpur. There are many hostels and the charge is Rs 4,000 approximately. Hostel condition is very good. The students live in a hostel and they enjoy their life.

reviews.review_heading: We have a heavy workload, and too much emphasis on attendance, but good networking and internships.
reviews.review_text: The department is overall nice. The infrastructure and campus are quite good but need more maintenance. The library is an amazing place to be in, canteen and food services are okay. Overall it is good, still needs to improve a lot. There is ample ground space and opportunities to engage in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is great.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and security are great. The hostel facility is good. The food is not that great. The campus has great Wi-Fi facilities all over the campus. The library is so beautiful with all the course books and extracurricular books as well. The quality of food in the mess is not at all good. Canteen food is better than mess food.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it provides the best and most reliable packages.
reviews.review_text: Libraries and hostel rooms are fantastic and clean. The service that is provided in the library and classrooms is very impressive, but sometimes Wi-Fi stops working, which is a manageable point. Medical facilities are also provided there for some small health issues. Ground is very big, so students can enjoy their recess and free time.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel, bedsheet pillow and pillow cover were provided and table was provided. Meal quality was not so good but breakfast was really very good. We could complete the registration from the official website of Amity University Lucknow.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Lucknow campus.
reviews.review_text: We have here Wi-Fi connections, computer labs, classrooms, and library. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is very good with good cleanliness, supportive wardens and staff. Rooms are also quite good and if we look for medical facilities here we have an infirmary in our hostel which has well-specialized doctors. And if we talk about sports and games here is very nice as we have a big backyard ground where we have basketball court, badminton court, cricket ground, and many indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University in Lucknow For M.Sc.  MB Course admission in 25-26.
reviews.review_text: This course's infrastructure quality is very good and uses high-quality materials and products. The college has classrooms, bathrooms, a library, a canteen, a hostel, etc. The canteen facilities are also good and there are many varieties of food available.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University in Uttar Pradesh, course and admission.
reviews.review_text: In this college, library facilities are available and there are all subject books present in the cell. Department classroom is very clean and the bathroom also. In this college, sports committee is organizing sports and games facilities but it is not free. There are charges and rise pool facilities available.

reviews.review_heading: My personal experience in Amity University Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good and furnished with all the facilities provided on the campus itself. Talking about the library, it is the best place on the whole campus to sit and study with the best decor. Here, the vibes are really impressive. Wi-Fi for the whole time is provided and we also have water coolers, a canteen, the best sitting areas, and fully air-conditioned corridors and classes too.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure structure is well maintained. The campus is very beautiful. Wi-Fi also works nicely. Classrooms are now maintained. The library is also very good. Books are available over there but the laboratories are not so okay because the AC doesn't work. Instruments and most chemicals are not available. Hostels are not at all good they are just overpriced and the mess food is not good.

admission_process.title: Siva Sivani Institute of Management Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Admissions atSiva Sivani Institute of Managementare based on entrance exams such as CAT/XAT/MAT/CMAT. While FPM admissions are based on SRAT conducted by theSSIM. The college has been ranked 2nd amongTop Private B-Schools (Hyderabad) by Outlook and offers courses such as PGDM, FPM and EFPM programme at PG and PhD levels.

Siva Sivani Institute of Management admissions are entrance-based. Candidates can apply for UG programme after Class 12. Graduation is required to apply for PG programme. Find belowSSIM Hyderabad coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Bachelor's degree with at least 50% aggregate in relevant subjects
MBA/ PGDM/ PG in allied subjects like Economics, Commerce and statistics with at least 60% aggregate
A graduate with professional qualifications like CA, ICWA, CS
Students may look below for a breakdown on the SSIM application process:
1. Application Process
Open the college official website to find the online application form and proceed to complete it by paying the prescribed application fee of INR 750.
2. Selection Rounds

Students must present a research proposal presentation for FPM and Statement of Purpose (SOP) along with a one-minute self-introduction video for PGDM. Shortlisted candidates must appear for further personal interview rounds for MBA.
3. Release of Offer Letter
If shortlisted, the institute issues and dispatches the offer letter through courier and e-mail.
4. Admission Confirmation and Fee Payment
Selected candidates have to pay the SSIM fee to confirm their seats in the institute.

review_content.General: The CIMP library, named LRC, has a huge resource of books from eminent writers and mentors, with separate space for reading and very easy access. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned and soundproof, so there is no disturbance. I like the college gym; the equipment is maintained and functional. Since the PGDM is a fully residential program, the hostel rooms are single bedrooms. The food quality is authentic, and there are two mess services on a monthly basis. For indoor sports like badminton and table tennis, there is a recreation centre in the college, and for outdoor sports like cricket and volleyball, there is a ground on the campus.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Best management institute in Bihar, good infrastructure, fine placement but a lot of strictness.

content.Placements: For my senior batch, out of 75 students 67 got placed. This year we are a batch of 108 students out of which only 25 are yet to be placed. The highest salary offered at our campus is of 15 lacs, the lowest 3.3 lacs and average salary offered is of 5.5 lacs. The top recruiters for our college is TASL, Asian Paints, ITC Ltd. , Colgate, Marico, Amul and Airtel. 100% of my batchmates got internship through our college. The top companies were CCI, Coca Cola, ITC Ltd. , Asian Paints, Amul and RBI.
content.Infrastructure: The college has all the requirements and meet the standards on all parameters to be defined as a B-School. It has all the facilities like Linrary, Wi-Fi, Access to Prowess database, AC and Smart classrooms. Talking about sports, our college has a badminton court, 2 table tennis boards, a cricket ground and a Volleyball court as well. Though people have an image of college mess food quality to be bad but the quality of food at our mess is quiet par when compared to other colleges mess. There are non AC and AC rooms available at the campus at same cost. The AC rooms have attached toilet but you will have to share the room with one of your colleagues and for the non AC rooms, you will have your own personal space but the toilets are many and you have to share them.

The infrastructure needs a good field and grounds for students to play outdoor sports, but we do have a basketball court and an indoor games section. We have the hostels for the first-year students and also have the mess facility. Apart from that, we have a good canteen where you can get good food at an affordable price.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indira College of Commerce and Science.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is really good. It has well-cleaned classrooms with a digital board and a good desk bench. The college does not allow students to use their Wi-Fi. Labs are well organised and the library also has a good source of books. The hostel is so strict. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is not that good. My college provides medical facilities. The college also has an ambulance service for students and staff members. In my college basketball and cricket are famou...

reviews.review_heading: Management college without any management.
reviews.review_text: Not up to the point, but still okay. The management is not worth it, and people staying there in the first year are not even staying there anymore, so this might be enough to describe it. Talking about the course, it does not have any issues; it is good and not so bad that you won't survive there.

reviews.review_heading: Learn corporate experience if you join this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good infrastructure. It has a good classroom with a digital board that can capacitate a class of 60 students. It has a good IT lab with a high-speed internet connection. It has a library that consists of around 3000 books and articles published by big authors.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best college in Pune for MBA through MBA CET.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is also good they provide you with dinner and lunch facilities along with Wi-Fi. In one room, there are 3 beds. The hostel is also very safe for girls and it is very near to the college. There is one route connected with the college campus and hostel directly.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indira Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in this course were so good. Wi-Fi is also available. Classrooms as well as the library, everything is present. The food quality in college was so good. Medical facilities were available. Sports and games were also available.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend to take admission to this college.
reviews.review_text: College and hostel infrastructure is good, but some colleges are quite better than our college. However, fees they demand are good and sufficient for a student. College also has computer labs, different offices for each section of work, and an aesthetic look to be captured in photos.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good college with a better future for corporate industry interviews.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi in certain areas of campus, well-equipped labs, classrooms with all facilities available, which makes it smart classrooms, all types of books are available in classrooms, the hostel is for girls only and it is in the campus itself, food is top-notch, medical facilities and sports.

library.description:
The library at IBI assumes a central role in supporting the intellectual pursuits of the academic community by providing a contemporary array of knowledge resources and innovative information services. This fully air-conditioned, state-of-the-art facility houses an extensive collection of printed and electronic resources, including approximately 4,000 books, databases, and more, all managed through the LivGuru software.
The library's holdings cover a diverse range of books across various management disciplines, along with magazines, journals, research papers, and theses. Currently, the library subscribes to 50 selected periodicals in both print and online formats, offering access to over 10,000 periodicals. Additionally, IBI features a dedicated e-Resource Centre for accessing electronic databases, journals, and reference sources. Affiliated with the Developing Library Network (DELNET) and National Digital Library (NDLI), the library provides access to a vast network of over 5,959 institutions (5,934 in India and 25 overseas).
Moreover, the IBI library boasts an impressive collection of 13,850 books and around 24 journals, encompassing both national and international publications. It subscribes to prestigious electronic databases such as Business Source Complete (EBSCO Publishing), Economic Outlook, J-gate Plus Social & Management Science Portal, and CMIE-PROWESS.
With a seating capacity of 80 students, the IBI library offers a well-lit, fully air-conditioned environment that fosters a peaceful ambiance, ideal for uninterrupted knowledge acquisition and skill development.

paragraphs: I Business Institute (IBI) offers a list of scholarships for its PGDM 2024-26 batch. A scholarship of up to INR 1,50,000 is available on first cum first-serve basis to the admitted candidates from the merit category based on their CAT/XAT/CMAT/MAT percentile. To avail of this scholarship, candidates are required to secure a minimum benchmark of an overall 60 percent in Class 10, 12 and Graduation. A maximum amount of INR 1,50,000 will be disbursed to I Business Institute candidates, who have secured more than 85 percentile in CAT/XAT/CMAT entrance exams.
DFP-Banner
Given below are the types of scholarships offered at I Business Institute:
1. Scholarship on the basis of qualifying exam:

The candidates should fall under the merit category on the basis of their percentile in CAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ MAT. Also, the candidate should fulfll the criteria of having secured an overall 60% in 10th, 12th, and Graduation.
Marks in Qualifying Exams
Scholarship Amount
CAT/ XAT/ CMAT percentile >85 / MAT Score >750
CAT/ XAT/ CMAT percentile between 70-85 / MAT Score between 700-749
CAT/ XAT/ CMAT percentile between 60-69 / MAT Score between 600-699
2. Scholarship on the basis of Academic Background:
The candidates having 70% and above in B.Tech/B.E degree and have also secured 70% & above in 10th & 12th will be awarded a scholarship of INR 30,000
3. Scholarship for candidates with Work Experience:

The candidates with at least 3 year of work experience or above with a minimum annual salary CTC of INR 3.5 LPA will receive a scholarship of INR 40,000. Candidates with a Experience of 5 years or above with a CTC of INR 5.5 LPA or higher will receive a scholarship of INR 50,000.
Note: No BPO Companies.
4. Single Mother:
The candidates, who are being raised by a Single Mother, will be awarded a scholarship of INR 50,000 provided the candidates should have secured 60% & above in 10th, 12th, and Graduation.
5. Meritorious Student:

A candidate who has achieved over 80% in their 10th, 12th, and graduation, as well as scored 85% percentile or higher in CAT/XAT, GMAT score of >650, and possesses 2 years of work experience with a 4LPA package, will be eligible for a 50% scholarship.* The Final scholarship will be awarded based on the candidate's performance in the selection process.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best college for the MSW course.
reviews.review_text: The overall performance was average. The buildings were not very good. Classrooms were average. Labs lacked proper equipment. There was only one library in the college, which was never open. The food at the hostel was average. The hospital facilities were worse. There was no platform for sports or extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: It is an absolutely good college.
reviews.review_text: The course contains all facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, a library, and smart classrooms. These are the facilities on the campus which are good and useful for everyone. The quality of food in the canteen is good and hygienic. In the canteen, there is a huge crowd.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with our faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides very good facilities in labs and classrooms. The hostel rooms are very good. The water facility is not good. Our canteen provides good food. There is no medical room in our college. Our college provides good facilities for sports like volleyball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good in terms of education.
reviews.review_text: Our college has 2 blocks. We have 150 classrooms, 10 computer labs, 1 physics lab, and 1 chemistry lab. Wi-Fi speed is very high. We have 2 libraries. Our college has 3 hostels. They provide 2 hostels for boys and 1 hostel for girls. We have a canteen. The food served in the canteen is good. Our college provides us with sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Our college was built in 1999 and is still good and famous college in Pollachi.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided a smart library, good Wi-Fi, and an i5 configuration system. The atmosphere at the college was pleasant. Medical facilities were available. A canteen was available. Wi-Fi was available, but sometimes, the speed was very low.

reviews.review_heading: This college has a pleasant environment to study in.
reviews.review_text: The canteen is good. The food served in the canteen is affordable. The college management greatly supports sports and games. They create many sports people. But they only focus on volleyball more because it gives tremendous success to them. The library is well furnished, with plenty of books.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sree Saraswathi Thyagaraja College.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides quite good placements. Many students got placed in reputed companies with very good salary packages. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, Muthoot Finance, Wipro, Intellipaat, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available throughout the campus. We had 10 computer labs, 14 smart classrooms, and other classrooms with LCD screens. There were three libraries. The hostel facilities were good. A mess and canteen were available. Medical facilities were available. Sports and games were good. Our college got the second-best sports college award at Bharathiyar University.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfies with placements, facilities, and ground of this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides a good library, labs, Wi-Fi, etc. Food served is acceptable. Hot water, a play area, etc., are provided. Football, cricket, volleyball, and basketball grounds are available. It has a very good canteen and yoga hall. Gym workout and weight-lifting training is provided.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the best atmosphere and faculty members of this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided in our college are top-notch. Free Wi-Fi, a library with a great collection of books, and a good study atmosphere are available. Hostel provides all the amenities including a play area, TV, Wi-Fi, a well-experienced warden, cleaning facilities, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Heart touching words of my career changer of my life.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities and freely available infrastructure are available for all the students and staff members. There is clean and perfect hostel infrastructure with suggested wardens. The college is supportive of medical facilities and has a favorable environment for sports and games. Good quality of food and medicines are available. Mess and canteen are available for hostel students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sree Saraswathi Thyagaraja College.
reviews.review_text: Unlimited free Wi-Fi for study purposes. Hostel infrastructure is not bad and is free for sports students. There are 2 libraries and an e-library with more than 45,000 commerce books, Tamil literature, computer science, and data science books.

reviews.review_heading: College with unique quality.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good and clean campus. Hostel for boys and girls which is placed north and south side of the college. The college have basketball and volleyball courts. College bus facility is available and 15 minds travel from pollachi. More buses are available from pollachi to college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good college for sport but not for studies.
reviews.review_text: The college is working on the infrastructure part. They have this stage idea to build high than build wide. They have no up-to-date computer systems or network they still revolve around the legacy systems. With the number of students going down each year and education cost getting high nothing good is happening here.

reviews.review_heading: Stc college is Nice place to study but not for placement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and hostel facility are nice. But there is no Wi-Fi. Lab Quality poor. Library was good. Classrooms are nice. I hear hostel facility was good but not for sure. Because I am not hostel student. Totally college infrastructure and hostel facility are nice.

admission_process.title: SRM Easwari Engineering College Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: SRM Easwari Engineering College admission 2025 isopen. The institute is affiliated withAnna Universityand offers UG and PG-level courses in the field of Engineering and Management such as BTech, MTech, MBA, etc.Easwari Engineering Collegeoffers direct admission to BTech and seats are allocated to candidates through TNEA Counselling. For admission to MTech, a valid GATE/ CEETA score is required. However,for MBA and MCA courses, candidates must qualify for TANCET. The final seat allotment is done through counselling process conducted by the respective examination bodies. Read on the article to know more about SRM Easwari Engineering College admission in detail.

Candidates seeking for admission to UG & PG courses at the institute must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective courses. Admissions are both entrance and merit-based. Check below the eligibility and selection criteria for the SRM Easwari Engineering College course admissions 2025:
Class 12 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry as main subjects from a recognised board
UG degree in any discipline either from Anna University or equivalent
UG degree in any discipline either from Anna University or equivalent
UG degree in any discipline either from Anna University or equivalent

SRM Easwari Engineering College admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The admission process includes filling the application form, appearing for the exam and registering for the counselling process. The detailed steps around theSRM Easwari Engineering College admission processare as follows:
STEP 1: Application Process

To apply for admission to UG & PG courses at SRM Easwari Engineering College, candidates must register on the official website of the respective entrance exam/ counselling bodies as per the course choice. For BTech, candidates must register for TNEA Counselling. For admission to MTech, students are required to register either for GATE or CEETA. However, MBA and MCA admissions begin with TANCET registrations.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

As per the admission process, direct admission is offered to BTech aspirants based on their past academic records. They only have to register for TNEA Counselling process. However, admission to MTech, MBA and MCA courses is entirely entrance-based. Candidates must qualify for exams such asGATE, CEET & TANCETfor their respective courses.
STEP 3: Counselling Process

Candidates who qualify all the selection rounds must register for counselling process for their respective courses. The final seat allotment will be done based on the participation of the students in the counselling rounds.

faqs.answer: No, you cannot join SRM Easwari Engineering College directly. Admission to SRM University is possible either through clearing the SRMJEEE entrance exam or direct admission through management quota. faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by SRM Easwari Engineering College?
faqs.answer: All the courses at Easwari Engineering College are offered in affiliation with Anna University. For admission to PG courses such as MBA and MTech, candidates are required to appear for the state-level TANCET entrance exam. This exam is conducted by Anna University and is valid for admission to all of its affiliated colleges across the Tamil Nadu state in PG courses. Further, for admission to MTech, the national-level GATE entrance exam is also accepted. Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the respective entrance exams to appear for them.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements for students.

review_content.Placements: They only give provisional placements for 3 months, and if you qualify provisional period, you get a permanent placement, but your package will be, like, 1.2 LPA. First three months, the HRs will treat you nicely, but as soon as your provisional period ends, they will get rude with you, as the responsibility of the university ends after the provisional period. They will react as if they never wanted to hire you.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure does not live up to the mark, especially if you are applying for Computer Science Engineering. Labs of CSE do not work most of the time, as we are using Windows 11 and the latest features on our PCs. But they are stuck on Windows 7 and 1 GB RAM computers, which cannot even handle two Chrome tabs. How will we design an AI model on these computers.

review_summary.college_name: Bahra University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college provides a good experience and good weather.

content.Placements: Around 50% of students get placed every year. The median package is 3-4 LPA. Most percent of students get placed in the internship. Physiotherapist roles are offered in our course, and we get Dr. Prefix and a medical course from a well-reputed college.
content.Infrastructure: We have a library and Wi-Fi available in the university. The classrooms are well-furnished, and the labs have equipment. The facilities in the hostel are good, with wooden beds, clean bathrooms, and separate washrooms for each room. The mess food is also okay, and medical facilities are also provided.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Very friendly teachers, average placements, good infrastructure, and beautiful environment.

content.Placements: Usually 60% of students get placement directly through the college. Maximum others are also able to land a good job on their own. The average package in B.Tech computer science is 8 LPA - 9 LPA, and the highest package given is 25 LPA. Infosys, Amazon, Microsoft, and many more are the top recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: The university is sitting on the lap of mother nature and is surrounded by green lush mountains. The weather here is optimal and moderately cold. It includes one physics lab, mechanical lab, chemistry lab, physiotherapy lab, and 2 computer labs. There are multiple sports grounds and basketball court in it with a mini football ground as well. The food here is moderate. They have one dispensary and one animal dispensary.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: If you just want to be a graduate or postgraduate, then only come to this college.

content.Placements: They only give provisional placements for 3 months, and if you qualify provisional period, you get a permanent placement, but your package will be, like, 1.2 LPA. First three months, the HRs will treat you nicely, but as soon as your provisional period ends, they will get rude with you, as the responsibility of the university ends after the provisional period. They will react as if they never wanted to hire you.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure does not live up to the mark, especially if you are applying for Computer Science Engineering. Labs of CSE do not work most of the time, as we are using Windows 11 and the latest features on our PCs. But they are stuck on Windows 7 and 1 GB RAM computers, which cannot even handle two Chrome tabs. How will we design an AI model on these computers.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Decent college, but it lacks preparation for the industry. The faculty is average.

content.Placements: I'm in my 2nd semester right now, so I don't have a complete understanding of placements but seniors told me that around 40 to 50 percent of students get placed. Companies like TCS, Wipro and Infosys usually come by. The roles offered are software developer, tech support and similar positions. Some students also do internships through platforms like Internshala or TCS iON but it's not for everyone. Overall, placement is average—not too good but not too bad.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is somewhat average. The classrooms are okay, but many don't have fans, which is a significant problem in the summer. The labs are fine, but not particularly updated. Wi-Fi is available, but it doesn't always work properly. The library is decent and has basic books. The hostel is alright; the rooms are not very big but manageable. The mess food is not very good; sometimes it’s okay, but mostly it’s not that tasty. The ground is also small, which is not ideal for playing properly. Overall, it’s been an average experience so far.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Very nice university give good placements.

content.Placements: About 90% of students were placed in BPT. The highest package was 25 LPA and the lowest package was 10 LPA. Physiomate was a recurring recruiter for the course. Around 99.9% of students got internships through the course, including in international companies, one even got selected as a sports physiotherapist for the Indian cricket team.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, and well-ventilated classrooms with AC were available, along with a huge library accessible 24/7. Water coolers with rat control measures were provided. The hostel facilities were good for bed students, and the quality of food was good. A physiotherapy OPD was available. However, there were no canteens. Sports and games were also conducted.

admission_overview.college_name: Bahra University Course Admission 2025: Eligibility & Selection Criteria

paragraphs: Bahra University admissionis open for all the courses. The university offers UG, PG, diploma and Doctoral programmes specialised in Engineering, Commerce, Pharmacy and others.Bahra Universityconducted an online mode of application. Admission to all the courses is both merit entrance based. Applicants looking for admission to the university can apply online through the official website of the university. Read the below article to know more about Bahra University admission, course-wise eligibility, selection criteria, seat, fees and admission process:

Bahra University offers entrance and merit-based admission to all its courses. Admission to all UG, PG, diploma and PhD courses is open. Candidates who meet the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective course will have to appear for the entrance exam for admission to BTech courses. Further, for other courses, admission is based on the last qualifying exam score and Counsellor Interaction. The CMRIT Central Library, provides an ideal environment for intellectual inquiry with its multiple Study Spaces, Research Assistance, Reading, Learning and Instructional Resources.
