reviews.review_heading: Review after 6 months in CMRIT, Bangalore. Exceed the expectations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is extremely beautiful, both interior and exterior. Wi-Fi is available as campus Wi-Fi. Labs are available for the subjects Python, C, Maths, Chemistry, and Physics in our department. There are also CAD labs. Classrooms have a conventional green board and a smart board. The library is extremely good, and most of my time goes there.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with decent placements and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The CSE department has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, a good library, and campus Wi-Fi, while the hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms, average but hygienic mess food, basic medical support, and adequate sports and recreational facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A good college for students to choose in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: I stay in the hostel, so it is average in terms of Wi-Fi and food. But in college, it is quite good in terms of Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, and the library. Labs are properly set up. So there are not many setup or electricity issues. The library is a gem for anyone who wants to study at their own pace and learn a lot.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for our course and hostel is average. Classrooms have basic facilities. Sometimes lack proper maintenance and hygiene. Wi-Fi is provided on campus and in libraries. Hostel rooms are manageable, but cleanliness and water supply should be improved.

reviews.review_heading: From classroom to career- What CMRIT gets right.
reviews.review_text: The campus is medium-sized but well organized. Classrooms are smart-board enabled. The library is spacious with good digital resources. Labs, sports areas, the canteen, and study spaces are well maintained. Hostel availability is good, but food quality is average. Labs are well maintained and practical focused.

reviews.review_heading: Good enough to enjoy the college life.
reviews.review_text: Good Wi-Fi is available. Labs, trainers, classrooms, hygiene, and a peaceful library are present. In the hostel, hygiene and food are good. The mess is okay. Medical facilities, sports, and games are all available. The college trains students with skills to make them ready for the industry.

reviews.review_heading: An overview of my college in all fields.
reviews.review_text: I am a day scholar, so I don't have much idea about hostel facilities. But when it comes to classrooms, they have newly added smart boards in most of the classes. Wi-Fi is available in most places on the college campus. There is a stationery shop as well as a canteen for students with seating arrangements.

reviews.review_heading: Life of a CMR IT CSE student.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college is really good. We have good Wi-Fi speed that goes up to 250 Mbps. All the computers are modern, and they have both Windows and Ubuntu operating systems to help students. Classrooms either have a smartboard or a projector. The food quality in the mess is good, the hostel also provides a good experience, but it is slightly costly, ranging from 1.4 lakh to 1.92 lakh. A sports room and gym are present with table tennis and other games.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with beautiful location
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good. It has all the necessary facilities. Classrooms are equipped with smart projectors and smart boards. All labs are also good with updated computers. The hostel is good but a bit expensive. The food is very decent.

reviews.review_heading: Prime location for IT placements with active student life, but the campus size is compact.
reviews.review_text: CMRIT College comes with a Wi-Fi-enabled campus and labs. Classrooms and libraries are well-maintained. Hostel food consists of a variety of items that are suitable for all residents. The campus also has a medical facility and supports participation in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of placement and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is okayish while labs are good. Classrooms don't have smart board and library is fine too. Wi-Fi in hostel is poor and there is no speed. There is no connectivity. Food is fine like I mean the usual price curry and idli dosa for breakfast. Canteen is fine too but some foods are overpriced. Sports facilities are good. There are cricket ground, basketball court, and tennis court too.

reviews.review_heading: Review on CMRIT as a First year student.
reviews.review_text: The CMRIT hostel is comfortable and convenient for the students to concentrate on their studies and campus life. The food quality is good, and mess hours are reasonable and well-coordinated so they do not interfere with class times. Safety is prioritized and considered an important factor for both students and parents. Plus, there are vending machines providing snacks and light refreshment which is very useful. On the whole, the hostel provides a decent, conducive environment for students living...

reviews.review_heading: Great college with top hackathon wings, supportive faculty, and excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are huge and spacious. Every classroom in the college is equipped with a whiteboard and a smart board. I don't have enough words to express my gratitude towards the unwavering support given by the college, not only in academics but also sports and cultural. CMRIT takes a lot of care when it comes to students' health so the food served in canteen is thoroughly inspected and checked so that students are served hygienic and tasty food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CMRIT from the first year's perspective.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure exceed expectations. The food quality is good. Sports grounds are also good. The hostel warden is strict and responsible. As one class of CS (AIML), the learning experience from our faculty is fairly good, and the Wi-Fi is good too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CMR Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: CMRIT has a modern and student-friendly campus that provides a good environment. The infrastructure is well developed. Most classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards. Large library with good seating capacity. The college has good canteen facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College is good, and students won't be disappointed in any of the aspects.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are proper. 24/7 Wi-Fi connection and labs for different purposes, which are helpful for research and development. Properly silent, good, and large library. Hostel quality is so good, the mess is clean, the canteen is clean, and it provides a variety. Medical facilities are also good, and sports and games are on top.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: It provides best infrastructure in all over Bangalore with free campus Wi-Fi. Classrooms are equipped with AC. International-level food, with big mess is available. Medical facilities and sports are the best. If we are interested in cultural activities and sports activities, they have best facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good academic institution with an awesome campus.
reviews.review_text: As our college has excellent infrastructure, which gives a good Wi-Fi, and our course is CSE, which has many projects and other activities like coding and hackathons. Coming to the library, it is a heavenly place that I have experienced. Classrooms are also good. Here, sports are given more preference as our college sports trophies are displayed in the sports room, at the state, national, and international levels.

reviews.review_heading: BMSCE review -Why you should join this college?
reviews.review_text: The best hostels are here with good food and facilities. It is within the campus, and students enjoy their lives here. The hostel canteens are very good, and the very famous medical facilities are also good, as they have their own hospital nearby. Wi-Fi is good, and the labs are very advanced.

reviews.review_heading: I would say the college is average and decent, it's just very hyped up because of its reputation.
reviews.review_text: The facilities you get are honestly average. The college has a huge reputation, but the campus is too small, and the main playground is small. The hostel and mess are decent. The buildings are well developed. But due to a lack of space, it's not easy to enjoy any event. It's okay, not too good, not too bad, but manageable. Just don't expect to have an elite feeling, hoping BMS College of Engineering is a top-tier 1 college. It's infrastructure is pretty decent.

reviews.review_heading: It is good. Facilities are average, clean, and games are good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average. But we have to adjust while coming for food. They maintain the hostel clean. Games are good.

reviews.review_heading: It has popularity and fame only because of old college. The infrastructure is bad.
reviews.review_text: The college is smaller than some schools. The hostel infrastructure is old and poor. Some hostels are not even near the college, around 3-4 km away. They provide old buses for those students. Some hostels are small for the number of students, and the indoor facilities are also small.

reviews.review_heading: The college unfiltered B. MS C. E
reviews.review_text: B. MS College of Engineering is well known for its infrastructure and the area where it is situated. The campus is very good, and the hostels are also good. Mess food is top notch, classrooms are well-equipped with AC and projectors, and we have two libraries.

reviews.review_heading: Good Professors, small campus, but chill college.
reviews.review_text: Every basic facility is available, like any other college. Hostels are less in numbers, so many students live in PG. Sports and games facilities are decent. Most of the hostels are far from the college like 4-7 km. They do provide a bus facility. Mess food is good.

reviews.review_heading: BMSCE, an overview of the college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite bad, and they need to loosen up their pockets because the hostels, labs and classes could use a much-needed upgrade, and they do take a lot of fees, so it wouldn't hurt them to streamline some of that cash to the benefit of the hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, our college is really very good for engineering placement.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very nice, but its also not that easy to get into the hostels, especially for girls. We have only 5 hostels, but if u join a hostel, we also have extra activities and events going on in the hostel, which is extra fun apart from the college fest.

reviews.review_heading: Vibrant campus life with amazing events and energetic crowd.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is overall okay. The total area of our college is less than the engineering colleges supposed to have, the library facilities are really good, but they are not sufficient during internals and final exams, its usually crowded during that time.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good and has a good reputation as a college in Bengaluru.

admission_overview.college_name: CMR College of Engineering and Technology Admission 2025: Fees, Courses, Eligibility and Selection

paragraphs: CMR College of Engineering and Technology admissionsare entrance-based. The college selects candidates based onEAMCET,GATEandICETscores for admission to specific programmes.CMRCEToffers admissions under Convener and Management Quota. The college offers courses at UG and PG levels in the Engineering and Management streams in affiliation withJNTUH.

The college offers admission to the offered programmes based on the entrance exam scores of the candidates. The minimum eligibility to apply for UG courses is Class 12, whereas graduation is required for PG programmes. Find belowCMRCET Hyderabad coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

CMR College of Engineering and Technology admissions begin with accepted exam registration. Candidates need to appear for any of the accepted entrance tests for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in the college:
Step 1: CMRCET Application Process 2025

Candidates need to fill out the application form for the accepted entrance exam. Aspirants can apply online for TS ICET, TS PGECET, and others as required by the applied course. Candidates need to pay an application fee to register for the test. In case of any query, aspirants can fill out the admission enquiry form.
Step 2: Selection

Admission to 70% seats (Convener Quota) of BTech is based on TS EAMCET scores. 30% seats are available for Category-B (Management Quota) admission. Besides, aspirants are selected based on TS ECET scores for BTech (Lateral Entry) courses. For MBA and MTech courses, the college considers scores in TS ICET and GATE/ TS PGECET, respectively.
Step 3: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Aspirants need to register for the accepted entrance exam counselling. The seats are offered to candidates based on their rank through counselling rounds. Aspirants need to choose CMRCET as a preferred college while filling out the form. Once selected, aspirants need to report at the campus for document verification. Aspirants also need to pay theCMRCET feeto confirm their seat in the college.

faqs.question: What is the seat intake for M.Tech at CMR College of Engineering and Technology?

faqs.question: How can I get admission at CMR College of Engineering and Technology?
faqs.answer: CMR College of Engineering and Technology admissions are entrance-based. The college offers admission to BTech and BTech (LE) programmes based on TS EAMCET, TS ECET scores, respectively. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, Zoho, and Amazon. 70 percent of students also get internship opportunities in reputed companies through college support. Most of the roles offered are software developer, data analyst, and associate engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at BIT is excellent. Classrooms are clean, well-lit, and equipped with smart boards. Every department has well-maintained labs with modern equipment and high-speed Wi-Fi. The central library is huge, with a good collection of books and digital resources. Hostel facilities are also very good. Rooms are neat, and food in the mess is hygienic, with a variety of dishes. Medical care, indoor and outdoor sports, and gym facilities are all available inside the campus.

individual_reviews.title: A decent college but needs work.

content.Placements: In my opinion, BIMS is an average college. Around 60-70% of students get placed. The highest package is approximately 6 LPA and the lowest is around 1.8 LPA. Companies like HDFC and Byju visit. Internships are offered but not to everyone. Roles are mostly in sales and marketing.
content.Infrastructure: My course had basic facilities like Wi-Fi, a library, and classrooms but no advanced labs. The hostel was average, and the food quality was okay. The canteen was decent. Medical help was limited. Some indoor games were available, overall sports facilities were lacking.

admission_process.title: Hindusthan College of Arts and Science Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: HICAS admission process 2025is both merit-based and entrance-based. HICAS accepts admission on the basis ofentrance testfor specific courses such asMBA, MCA, and PhD. Whereas for remaining courses, direct admission is offered based on the merit of the last qualifying exam of candidates. HICAS application forms can be filled in bothonlineandofflinemodes.
Hindusthan College of Arts and Scienceis affiliated withBharathiar University, Coimbatore. Read the complete article to know more about Hindusthan College of Arts and Science admission.

The institute offers admission to over57 coursesat UG, PG, and PhD levels across various streams, such asArts & Humanities, ScienceandAccounting, and Commerce. Apart from this, HICAS also offers 5 diploma and certificate courses. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria forHICAS courses:
GATE/UGC NET/CSIR NET
Read More:HICAS Admission PolicyandHICAS Admission Brochure 2025

Hindusthan College of Arts and Science admission consists of multiple steps. HICAS admission begins with an online/ offline registration process. Interested students can check out the following section to learn more about Hindusthan College of Arts and Science admission in detail:
HICAS Application Process

HICAS accepts both online/ offline applications for admission to UG & PG courses. Candidates must fill an application form either on the university's official website or they can submit a hard copy of the application form to HICAS.

For PhD course admission, candidates must apply offline. The candidates who want to apply for M. Phil/ PhD programme are advised to visit the official university website. Candidates can download the application from the website. The candidates have to download two copies of the application and submit the filled in application at college.
HICAS Selection Rounds
For MBA & MCA course, students are admitted based on TANCET scores. Whereas for other UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on their merit of the last qualifying exam.
HICAS Merit List Release & Fee Payment

Hindusthan College of Arts and Science admission is subjected to the rules of reservation of the Government of Tamil Nadu andBharathiar University, Coimbatore. A partial 50% of the seats are filled as per the reservation policy stipulated by the regulatory bodies and 50% of the seats are filled through Management Quota. The shortlisted candidates will be notified through merit lists. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theHindusthan College of Arts and Science feeto confirm their seats in the university.

reviews.review_heading: Great place for education and enjoyment.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, library, and classrooms are awesome with great facilities and also with many advanced software programs used in this course. Hostel food is not really always good but canteen food is good. It is a college that supports much in extra-curricular activities like sports and cultural events.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for the MBA course.
reviews.review_text: The college offered digital learning, projector-based learning, a digital library, Wi-Fi in the library, and charging ports. Although there is no hostel, the food served in the restaurant is always fresh and interesting. Additionally, there is a medical aid box and a medical room. The bathroom is clean and hygienic. The college also has special facilities for athletics and sports.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college, etc.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at our college is good, with good facilities. There are many departments available in our college. The quality of the facilities in our hostel, the quality of food available in the mess and canteen, and medical facilities are good enough.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Hindusthan College of Arts and Science [HICAS]
reviews.review_text: 89% of the marks were placed in my course. A minimum of 10,000 to 200,000 was offered in my course. L&T company and Infosys company offer placements to my college. 50% of people got internships from my course in Infosys. Jobs are available in IT companies and trading companies.

reviews.review_heading: Strong foundation, practical skills, bright career prospects, and so many events.
reviews.review_text: Well, the labs and classrooms were not so good at the same time. The labs were average and the system was okay. Few of the systems may not be in working condition. The Wi-Fi connection was also average, not good. There were a lot of canteens available in this college. The price range was also valued for the product. The food was good but hostel food was the worst. This college had own hospital with the same name as the college so don't worry about medical facilities. In sports, they give importa...

reviews.review_heading: My college has no limits.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is pretty good and it is a very old college. With a good reputation and classrooms are very hi-fi and have a good Wi-Fi network. It has a hi-tech library. Food in the mess and canteen is good. It has a mobile hospital in our college. In our college, students have secured many medals and shields in various sports competitions.

reviews.review_heading: It's worth the money. You should give it a try.
reviews.review_text: There are numerous labs, and separate hostels for men and women, with options like normal, deluxe, semi-deluxe, super deluxe, and ultra-deluxe. There are more than 15 canteens and a large auditorium.

reviews.review_heading: It is a tech-driven campus with strong placements and vibrant student life.
reviews.review_text: The department offers well-equipped labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart classrooms and a central library with vast academic resources. The hostel has clean rooms, decent food in the mess and canteen, 24x7 medical support and good sports facilities including indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Why it has the best academics and faculty?
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi and separate labs for fabric design, drafting, stitching, and pattern making. The labs have all the necessary equipment for our use. Classrooms are smart classrooms. The college has a very accessible library as well. Hostel facilities were good and secure, and there is a hospital clinic inside, so there is no need to fear.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with the college. The infrastructure is great.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like free Wi-Fi, air-conditioned labs, air-conditioned classrooms, and a library with all essential books are provided. Hostels are facilitated with hot water both for bathing and drinking. Rooms are provided with cots, chairs, and study desks. The mess food menu is not very great. The food quality is low but adjustable. Hindustan Hospital is nearby and the only medicine fee is for students with college ID. There is a basketball court, badminton court, and cricket ground.

reviews.review_heading: Life at HICAS is a blissful moment in my career.
reviews.review_text: Our MAAC dept offers many facilities unlike other departments, like air-conditioned classrooms, and computer labs that are open until 7 pm. College Wi-Fi is good too, and many necessary books are available at the library, and some fun novels like Harry Potter are available too. You may use your ID card to enter the library. Hostels have facilities like hot drinking water, and hot water in the morning for bathing. Food quality is not bad. There would be canteens everywhere, and a ground near the ...

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for MBA Course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are the best. The library has a large collection of books on various subjects and also offers free Wi-Fi. Wi-Fi connections are also provided at some other locations. Many eateries are present on campus. There is also a hospital within the campus. We have 5 grounds, a sports complex, and a courtyard inside most of the hostels where the students also play football, cricket, hockey, and other sports.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for those who want to enjoy without worrying about career.
reviews.review_text: In terms of facilities and infrastructure, it is good. Not very worse. Perhaps in a few classrooms we will experience some minor issues. UG students will get to learn through smart classes with projectors. Most of the time, that is frequently available for PG students. Hostel food is not likable.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for M.Com. In Computer Application Course.
reviews.review_text: The products and services offered at our college are extensive. Classrooms are equipped with air conditioning and air conditioning. Our campus has shared free Wi-Fi. The library is spacious with many books. The hotel is very clean. Food and care are good. Restaurants and medical facilities have been built there. There are sporting and cultural activities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for MBA Course.
reviews.review_text: Football and cricket fields are available at our university, along with badminton and basketball facilities. Both the science and art libraries on campus include a large collection of books and journals, but they are not digital. There is Wi-Fi on campus, which gives users access to premium journals. The library didn't have some books.

paragraphs: FMS Delhi 2025 admission involves a systematic and multiphase course.Potential students should thoroughly consider eligibility requirements prior to them embarking on the application procedure.Each step is broken down into a substantial form below:
STEP 1: FMS Delhi Application Process

Applicants who are keen to seek the admission in FMS Delhi should begin by filling the on-line form.Application to the institution is done via its official site, which is www.fms.edu. The applicants are required to make sure that they apply and remit the required application fee by the time stated.
STEP 2: Application Screening & Shortlisting

After the application period, candidate screening is done.The screening entails eligibility and selection criteria.The shortlisting of the applicants is done through academic records and other qualifications as mentioned in the eligibility criteria.
STEP 3: Statement of Purpose

Candidates are also required to submit a Statement of Purpose to the FMS Delhi, outlining why they are a fitting candidate for their chosen course. The shortlisting process will take the statement of purpose into consideration to decide a candidate's admission.The step assists in measuring the applicability of the candidates to the EMBA programme.
STEP 4: Personal Interview

Candidates whose applications are shortlisted for admissions are called for a Personal Interview round. In this round, candidates are required to appear before a selection committee which will ask the candidates several questions regarding their personal interests, reasons for choosing the course, their knowledge of the current state of the industry and their plans for the future.
STEP 5: Confirmation of Admissions

Once the interview rounds have taken place, the institution can send an email or whatever other channel is available to the students selected so that they receive confirmation of their admission status.In order to ensure their admission, successful students will be obliged to take the required preparations for admission and as per that, they will be required to handover the required documents in the stipulated deadline, which will confirm the seat in the programme.

faqs.answer: The two year MBA course at FMS Delhi is significantly lower as compared to other reputed Indian B-schools such as IIM and XLRI and the entire cost of the course amounts to INR 2 lakhs.There are two significant factors in the reduced charges.To begin with, FMS is a department of the publicly-funded University of Delhi and gets government grants to make tuition affordable.Second, the school has a good alumni network that provides the school with financial assistance and assists in financing new infrastructure improvements such as new classrooms and libraries.The information is summarized on the web and could be suggestive.To find out more visit the official site.

paragraphs: FMS Delhi placement report 2025 is yet to be released. However, FMS Delhi summer placement report of the batch 2024-2026 is available on the official website. faqs.question: What is the process of shortlisting the MBA students for interview at FMS Delhi?
faqs.answer: The process of shortlisting the candidates for interview for admission to the MBA course at FMS Delhi is based on CAT scores and graduation scores. Moreover, to promote diversity in gender and academic fields, CAT 2024 scores from various sections will be given different weights to shortlist applicants for the interview process and final selection. For the final selection, a weightage score will be calculated, weights of 40%, 30%, and 30% to the scores of QA (Quantitative Ability), DILR (Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning), and VARC (Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension). Additionally, five (5) marks shall be added to the weighted score in case women candidates to shortlisted for the interview process.
